FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS sat

    'Unified School District',
    'High School District',

SELECT CASE MIN(CASE
    WHEN GSserved LIKE 'P%' THEN 0
    WHEN GSserved LIKE 'TK%' THEN 0
    WHEN GSserved LIKE 'K%' THEN 1
    WHEN GSserved GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(GSserved AS INTEGER)
END)
    WHEN 0 THEN 'P'
    WHEN 1 THEN 'K'
    ELSE CAST(MIN(CASE
        WHEN GSserved LIKE 'P%' THEN 0
        WHEN GSserved LIKE 'TK%' THEN 0
        WHEN GSserved LIKE 'K%' THEN 1
        WHEN GSserved GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(GSserved AS INTEGER)
    END) - 1 AS TEXT)
END AS lowest_grade
FROM schools
WHERE NCESDist = '0632640'
  AND GSserved IS NOT NULL;

WITH district_list AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT County, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE County IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
      AND DOCType IN (
          'Unified School District',
          'Elementary School District',
          'High School District',
          'County Office of Education (COE)'
      )
),
school_admins AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, District, AdmFName1 AS first_name
    FROM schools
    WHERE County IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
      AND DOCType IN (
          'Unified School District',
          'Elementary School District',
          'High School District',
          'County Office of Education (COE)'
      )
      AND School IS NOT NULL
      AND AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT CDSCode, District, AdmFName2
    FROM schools
    WHERE County IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
      AND DOCType IN (
          'Unified School District',
          'Elementary School District',
          'High School District',
          'County Office of Education (COE)'
      )
      AND School IS NOT NULL
      AND AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT CDSCode, District, AdmFName3
    FROM schools
    WHERE County IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
      AND DOCType IN (
          'Unified School District',
          'Elementary School District',
          'High School District',
          'County Office of Education (COE)'
      )
      AND School IS NOT NULL
      AND AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL
),
top_names AS (
    SELECT first_name
    FROM school_admins
    GROUP BY first_name
    ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT CDSCode) DESC, first_name ASC
    LIMIT 2
)
SELECT
    d.District AS district_name,
    t.first_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.first_name = t.first_name THEN a.CDSCode END) AS school_count
FROM district_list AS d
CROSS JOIN top_names AS t
LEFT JOIN school_admins AS a
    ON a.District = d.District
   AND a.first_name = t.first_name
GROUP BY d.County, d.District, t.first_name
ORDER BY d.County, d.District, t.first_name;

FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
   AND f.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(t.NumTstTakr, 0)), 2) AS average_test_takers_per_school
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.OpenDate >= '2007-01-01'
  AND s.OpenDate < '2008-01-01'
  AND s.DOCType IN (
      'Elementary School District',
      'High School District',
      'Unified School District'
  );

WITH active_charters AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, FundingType
    FROM schools
    WHERE StatusType = 'Active'
      AND Charter = 1
      AND FundingType IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
),
funding_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ac.FundingType,
        COUNT(*) AS school_count,
        SUM(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS total_enrollment,
        AVG(f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`) AS avg_frpm_eligible_pct
    FROM active_charters AS ac
    LEFT JOIN frpm AS f
        ON f.CDSCode = ac.CDSCode
       AND f.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'
    GROUP BY ac.FundingType
),
sat_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ac.FundingType,
        AVG(s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_combined_sat
    FROM active_charters AS ac
    JOIN satscores AS s
        ON s.cds = ac.CDSCode
    WHERE s.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
      AND s.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
      AND s.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ac.FundingType
)
SELECT
    fs.FundingType,
    fs.school_count,
    fs.total_enrollment,
    ROUND(fs.avg_frpm_eligible_pct, 2) AS avg_frpm_eligible_pct,
    ROUND(ss.avg_combined_sat, 2) AS avg_combined_sat
FROM funding_stats AS fs
LEFT JOIN sat_stats AS ss
    ON ss.FundingType = fs.FundingType
ORDER BY fs.FundingType;

SELECT
    s.School AS school_name,
    f.`Low Grade` AS earliest_grade_level,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS enrollment_k12,
    COALESCE(sat.NumTstTakr, 0) AS sat_test_takers
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
    ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOCType = 'State Special Schools'
  AND f.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'
  AND s.School IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    CASE f.`Low Grade`
        WHEN 'P' THEN 0
        WHEN 'K' THEN 1
        WHEN '1' THEN 2
        WHEN '2' THEN 3
        WHEN '3' THEN 4
        WHEN '4' THEN 5
        WHEN '5' THEN 6
        WHEN '6' THEN 7
        WHEN '7' THEN 8
        WHEN '8' THEN 9
        WHEN '9' THEN 10
        WHEN '10' THEN 11
        WHEN '11' THEN 12
        WHEN '12' THEN 13
        ELSE 14
    END DESC,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC,
    s.School ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.School IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.School) <> ''
  AND CAST(f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS REAL) > 500
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(s.GSserved, INSTR(s.GSserved, '-') + 1) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 8
  AND (t.cds IS NULL OR t.NumTstTakr = 0);

SELECT
    s.FundingType,
    COUNT(*) AS operating_schools,
    SUM(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS total_k12_enrollment,
    SUM(f.`FRPM Count (K-12)`) AS total_frpm_eligible_k12_students
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOCType = 'County Office of Education (COE)'
  AND s.Charter = 1
  AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
  AND s.FundingType IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
GROUP BY s.FundingType
ORDER BY CASE s.FundingType
    WHEN 'Directly funded' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Locally funded' THEN 2
END;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
  AND s.State = 'CA'
  AND s.EILName = 'High School'
  AND (sat.cds IS NULL OR sat.NumTstTakr = 0);
SELECT 519.0 / 12;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.Virtual IN ('F', 'P') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    1
) AS percentage
FROM satscores AS a
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = a.cds
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
  AND a.AvgScrMath > 400;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        s.CDSCode,
        s.School,
        s.GSserved,
        s.Charter,
        f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS free_meal_rate
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'
      AND s.GSserved IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(substr(s.GSserved, instr(s.GSserved, '-') + 1) AS INTEGER) >= 12
      AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
      AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
),
top_schools AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM eligible
    WHERE free_meal_rate = (SELECT MAX(free_meal_rate) FROM eligible)
)
SELECT
    t.School AS school_name,
    printf('%.4f', t.free_meal_rate) AS free_meal_rate,
    CASE
        WHEN t.Charter = 1 THEN 'Yes'
        WHEN t.Charter = 0 THEN 'No'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS charter_school,
    t.GSserved AS grades_served,
    CASE
        WHEN sat.AvgScrRead IS NULL
          OR sat.AvgScrMath IS NULL
          OR sat.AvgScrWrite IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
        WHEN sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
        WHEN sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
        ELSE 'Above Average'
    END AS sat_performance_level
FROM top_schools AS t
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = t.CDSCode;

WITH target AS (
    SELECT
        s.School AS school_name,
        s.Phone AS phone_number,
        s.Website AS website,
        s.Charter AS is_charter,
        t.AvgScrRead AS average_sat_reading,
        t.AvgScrMath AS average_sat_math,
        t.AvgScrWrite AS average_sat_writing,
        f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12_2014_2015,
        ROUND(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" * 100, 2) AS frpm_eligible_percentage
    FROM schools AS s
    LEFT JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
    LEFT JOIN frpm AS f
        ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
       AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
    WHERE s.CDSCode = '07618040113118'
),
highest AS (
    SELECT MAX(t.AvgScrMath) AS highest_active_school_sat_math
    FROM satscores AS t
    JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
    WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
      AND t.NumTstTakr >= 10
)
SELECT
    target.school_name,
    target.phone_number,
    target.website,
    target.average_sat_reading,
    target.average_sat_math,
    target.average_sat_writing,
    target.is_charter,
    target.enrollment_k12_2014_2015,
    target.frpm_eligible_percentage,
    highest.highest_active_school_sat_math,
    highest.highest_active_school_sat_math - target.average_sat_math
        AS points_below_highest_math
FROM target
CROSS JOIN highest;

WITH virtual_counts AS (
  SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS school_count
  FROM schools
  WHERE Virtual = 'F'
  GROUP BY County
),
ranked_counties AS (
  SELECT County, school_count,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY school_count DESC) AS county_rank
  FROM virtual_counts
),
top_counties AS (
  SELECT County, school_count
  FROM ranked_counties
  WHERE county_rank <= 5
),
virtual_scores AS (
  SELECT s.County, s.School, sc.AvgScrRead
  FROM schools AS s
  LEFT JOIN satscores AS sc
    ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
),
maxima AS (
  SELECT County, MAX(AvgScrRead) AS max_read
  FROM virtual_scores
  GROUP BY County
)
SELECT tc.County,
       tc.school_count,
       COALESCE(
         GROUP_CONCAT(
           CASE WHEN vs.AvgScrRead = m.max_read THEN vs.School END,
           ', '
         ),
         'None'
       ) AS school
FROM top_counties AS tc
JOIN maxima AS m
  ON m.County = tc.County
LEFT JOIN virtual_scores AS vs
  ON vs.County = tc.County
 AND vs.AvgScrRead = m.max_read
GROUP BY tc.County, tc.school_count, m.max_read
ORDER BY tc.school_count DESC, tc.County;

WITH target_counties AS (
    SELECT 'Santa Barbara' AS County
    UNION
    SELECT County
    FROM schools
    WHERE CDSCode = '01100170109835'
),
county_counts AS (
    SELECT tc.County, COUNT(s.CDSCode) AS exclusive_virtual_schools
    FROM target_counties AS tc
    LEFT JOIN schools AS s
        ON s.County = tc.County
       AND s.Virtual = 'F'
    GROUP BY tc.County
)
SELECT County, exclusive_virtual_schools
FROM county_counts
ORDER BY exclusive_virtual_schools DESC, County ASC;

SELECT s.School AS name, s.Street AS street_address
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.School IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.School) <> ''
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 30
  AND CASE
        WHEN f."High Grade" = 'K' THEN 0
        ELSE CAST(f."High Grade" AS INTEGER)
      END <= 8;

SELECT s.School, s.Street
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE CAST(f."Low Grade" AS INTEGER) >= 9
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 30
ORDER BY s.CDSCode ASC;

SELECT s.AdmFName1, s.AdmLName1
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = (
    SELECT County
    FROM schools
    WHERE CDSCode = '1611430131177'
)
  AND sat.rtype = 'S'
ORDER BY sat.NumGE1500 DESC, s.CDSCode ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM satscores AS t
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE t.NumTstTakr >= 700
  AND t.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (1.0 * t.NumGE1500 / t.NumTstTakr) ASC,
         CAST(t.cds AS INTEGER) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    s.School AS School_Name,
    s.Street AS Street_Address,
    s.City,
    s.State,
    s.Zip AS ZIP_Code
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Los Angeles'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 500
  AND f.`School Type` IN (
      'High Schools (Public)',
      'Continuation High Schools',
      'High Schools In 1 School Dist. (Public)'
  )
ORDER BY s.School;

SELECT
    s.County AS county_name,
    SUM(COALESCE(sa.NumTstTakr, 0)) AS total_sat_test_takers
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sa
    ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
  AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Provision 2'
GROUP BY s.County;

WITH per_printing AS (
    SELECT c.uuid, c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo, COUNT(r.id) AS ruling_count
    FROM cards AS c
    LEFT JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
    GROUP BY c.uuid
),
max_rulings AS (
    SELECT MAX(ruling_count) AS max_count
    FROM per_printing
)
SELECT DISTINCT name, artist, isPromo
FROM per_printing
WHERE ruling_count = (SELECT max_count FROM max_rulings)
ORDER BY name, artist, isPromo;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fd.language = 'Chinese Simplified' THEN c.uuid END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM cards AS c
LEFT JOIN foreign_data AS fd
    ON fd.uuid = c.uuid;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.language = 'French' THEN c.uuid END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid),
    2
) AS percentage_with_french_translation
FROM cards AS c
LEFT JOIN foreign_data AS f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.isStorySpotlight = 1;

SELECT id
FROM cards
WHERE duelDeck = 'a'
ORDER BY id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE LOWER(c.borderColor) = 'white'
  AND LOWER(l.status) = 'banned';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS count
FROM cards c
WHERE (c.power IS NULL OR c.power = '' OR c.power LIKE '%*%')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM rulings r
    WHERE r.uuid = c.uuid
      AND r.text LIKE '%triggered ability%'
  );

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.hasContentWarning = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage_without_content_warning
FROM legalities AS l
JOIN cards AS c ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE l.format = 'commander'
  AND l.status = 'Legal';

WITH format_counts AS (
    SELECT format, COUNT(*) AS banned_printing_records
    FROM legalities
    WHERE lower(status) = 'banned'
    GROUP BY format
),
top_format AS (
    SELECT format
    FROM format_counts
    ORDER BY banned_printing_records DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT tf.format, c.name
FROM top_format AS tf
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.format = tf.format
JOIN cards AS c ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE lower(l.status) = 'banned'
GROUP BY tf.format, c.name
ORDER BY c.name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.name)
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.isPromo = 1
  AND c.types LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND l.format = 'brawl'
  AND l.status = 'Legal';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE borderColor = 'black' AND availability LIKE '%mtgo%' AND CAST(power AS REAL) >= 10;

SELECT COUNT(c.id) AS total_cards
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st ON st.setCode = s.code
LEFT JOIN cards AS c ON c.setCode = s.code
GROUP BY s.code
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT st.translation) < 5
;

WITH translated_sets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT setCode
    FROM set_translations
    WHERE translation IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(translation) <> ''
),
per_set AS (
    SELECT
        s.code,
        s.type,
        CASE WHEN ts.setCode IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_translated,
        COUNT(c.id) AS card_count
    FROM sets AS s
    LEFT JOIN translated_sets AS ts ON ts.setCode = s.code
    LEFT JOIN cards AS c ON c.setCode = s.code
    GROUP BY s.code, s.type, ts.setCode
)
SELECT
    type,
    SUM(is_translated) AS translated_set_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_translated = 1 THEN card_count ELSE 0 END) AS translated_set_card_count
FROM per_set
GROUP BY type
ORDER BY type;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS ruling_count
FROM rulings r
JOIN cards c ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Mishra''s Factory'
  AND r.date = (
      SELECT MAX(r2.date)
      FROM rulings r2
      JOIN cards c2 ON c2.uuid = r2.uuid
      WHERE c2.name = 'Mishra''s Factory'
  );

WITH artist_counts AS (
  SELECT artist, COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS creature_card_count
  FROM cards
  WHERE types LIKE '%Creature%'
    AND artist IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY artist
)
SELECT artist, creature_card_count
FROM artist_counts
WHERE creature_card_count = (
  SELECT MAX(creature_card_count)
  FROM artist_counts
);

WITH newest AS (
  SELECT MAX(frameVersion) AS frameVersion
  FROM cards
  WHERE convertedManaCost = 0
    AND frameVersion IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT cards.frameVersion, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards
JOIN newest ON cards.frameVersion = newest.frameVersion
GROUP BY cards.frameVersion;

SELECT
    frameVersion AS latest_frame_year,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE name = 'Tarmogoyf'),
        2
    ) AS percentage_of_printings
FROM cards
WHERE name = 'Tarmogoyf'
  AND frameVersion = (
      SELECT frameVersion
      FROM cards
      WHERE name = 'Tarmogoyf'
        AND frameVersion GLOB '[0-9]*'
      ORDER BY CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER) DESC
      LIMIT 1
  )
GROUP BY frameVersion;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.name) AS card_count
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.manaCost = '{0}'
  AND l.format = 'commander'
  AND l.status = 'Legal';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_cards
FROM cards
WHERE keywords LIKE '%Flying%'
  AND keywords LIKE '%Cycling%';

SELECT c.name, c.number AS collector_number, COUNT(fd.id) AS foreign_language_printings
FROM cards AS c
LEFT JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.watermark = 'abzan'
  AND c.number = (
      SELECT number
      FROM cards
      WHERE watermark = 'abzan'
      ORDER BY LENGTH(number) DESC, number DESC
      LIMIT 1
  )
GROUP BY c.uuid;

SELECT name
FROM cards
WHERE setCode = 'DKA'
  AND keywords LIKE '%Flash%'
  AND text LIKE '%Flash (%'
  AND convertedManaCost = (
    SELECT MAX(convertedManaCost)
    FROM cards
    WHERE setCode = 'DKA'
      AND keywords LIKE '%Flash%'
      AND text LIKE '%Flash (%'
  )
ORDER BY name;

SELECT
    s.name,
    s.keyruneCode,
    COUNT(DISTINCT st.language) AS language_count
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st
    ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2020-01-01'
  AND s.releaseDate < '2021-01-01'
GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.keyruneCode
ORDER BY s.releaseDate, s.name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cards
FROM cards
WHERE setCode IN (
    SELECT s.code
    FROM sets AS s
    WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2017-01-01'
      AND s.releaseDate < '2018-01-01'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM set_translations AS st
          WHERE st.setCode = s.code
            AND st.language <> 'English'
      )
);

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM cards
WHERE duelDeck = 'b'
  AND hasFoil = 0
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) < 3;

SELECT artist, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'black'
  AND availability LIKE '%arena%'
  AND power GLOB '[0-9]*'
  AND CAST(power AS INTEGER) >= 10
GROUP BY artist
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
  SELECT MAX(card_count)
  FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_count
    FROM cards
    WHERE borderColor = 'black'
      AND availability LIKE '%arena%'
      AND power GLOB '[0-9]*'
      AND CAST(power AS INTEGER) >= 10
    GROUP BY artist
  )
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE hasContentWarning = 1
  AND availability LIKE '%paper%'
  AND availability NOT LIKE '%mtgo%';

SELECT s.type AS expansion_type,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS japanese_name_set_count
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st
  ON st.setCode = s.code
 AND st.language = 'Japanese'
GROUP BY s.type
ORDER BY s.type;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT artist)
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'black'
  AND availability LIKE '%arena%'
  AND availability NOT LIKE '%mtgo%'
  AND types LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND power GLOB '[0-9]*'
  AND power NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
  AND CAST(power AS INTEGER) >= 5
  AND artist IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM cards
WHERE setCode = 'UMA'
  AND type LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND power IS NOT NULL
  AND toughness IS NOT NULL
  AND power NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
  AND toughness NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
  AND CAST(power AS INTEGER) > CAST(toughness AS INTEGER);

SELECT '2015' AS frame_year, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE leadershipSkills LIKE '%commander%'
  AND leadershipSkills LIKE '%True%'
  AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
  AND frameVersion = '2015';

WITH card_counts AS (
  SELECT c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS ruling_count
  FROM cards c
  JOIN rulings r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
  WHERE c.originalType = 'Creature - Elf'
  GROUP BY c.name
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT name, ruling_count, MAX(ruling_count) OVER () AS max_count
  FROM card_counts
)
SELECT name, ruling_count
FROM ranked
WHERE ruling_count = max_count
ORDER BY name;

SELECT c.colors AS card_color, COUNT(DISTINCT l.format) AS legal_play_formats
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.id BETWEEN 1 AND 20
  AND l.status = 'Legal'
GROUP BY c.colors
ORDER BY c.colors;

SELECT frameVersion, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE artist = 'John Avon'
  AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId <> ''
  AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomFoilId <> ''
GROUP BY frameVersion
HAVING frameVersion = (
    SELECT MAX(frameVersion)
    FROM cards
    WHERE artist = 'John Avon'
      AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId <> ''
      AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomFoilId <> ''
);

SELECT cardKingdomFoilId, cardKingdomId
FROM cards
WHERE types LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY cardKingdomFoilId, cardKingdomId
LIMIT 3;

SELECT c.type, COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS card_count
FROM cards AS c
WHERE LOWER(c.watermark) = 'boros'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM foreign_data AS f
    WHERE f.uuid = c.uuid
      AND LOWER(f.language) <> 'english'
  )
GROUP BY c.type
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) = (
  SELECT MAX(type_count)
  FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c2.uuid) AS type_count
    FROM cards AS c2
    WHERE LOWER(c2.watermark) = 'boros'
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM foreign_data AS f2
        WHERE f2.uuid = c2.uuid
          AND LOWER(f2.language) <> 'english'
      )
    GROUP BY c2.type
  )
);

WITH guild_counts AS (
    SELECT
        lower(c.watermark) AS guild,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS card_count
    FROM cards AS c
    WHERE lower(c.watermark) IN (
        'azorius', 'boros', 'dimir', 'golgari', 'gruul',
        'izzet', 'orzhov', 'rakdos', 'selesnya', 'simic'
    )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM foreign_data AS f
          WHERE f.uuid = c.uuid
            AND f.language IS NOT NULL
            AND lower(f.language) <> 'english'
      )
    GROUP BY lower(c.watermark)
)
SELECT guild, card_count
FROM guild_counts
WHERE card_count = (SELECT MAX(card_count) FROM guild_counts)
ORDER BY guild;

SELECT c.type, COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS card_count
FROM cards AS c
WHERE c.watermark = 'azorius'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM foreign_data AS f
    WHERE f.uuid = c.uuid
      AND f.language IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(f.language) <> ''
  )
GROUP BY c.type
ORDER BY card_count DESC, c.type ASC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT scryfallOracleId)
FROM cards
WHERE frameVersion IN ('2015', 'future')
  AND text IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(text) <> '';

SELECT DISTINCT name
FROM cards
WHERE isPromo = 1
  AND originalReleaseDate >= '2019/01/01'
  AND originalReleaseDate <= '2019/12/31'
  AND otherFaceIds IS NOT NULL
  AND otherFaceIds <> ''
ORDER BY name;

SELECT DISTINCT s.name AS set_name, s.releaseDate
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setCode
WHERE c.name = 'Tarmogoyf'
  AND c.isReprint = 1
  AND CAST(substr(s.releaseDate, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(c.frameVersion AS INTEGER) >= 10
ORDER BY s.releaseDate;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM (
    SELECT c.setCode, c.number
    FROM cards AS c
    JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setCode
    WHERE c.name = 'Counterspell'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM set_translations AS f
          WHERE f.setCode = c.setCode AND f.language = 'French'
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM set_translations AS i
          WHERE i.setCode = c.setCode AND i.language = 'Italian'
      )
    GROUP BY c.setCode, c.number
);

SELECT DISTINCT s.name, s.releaseDate
FROM sets AS s
WHERE s.type = (
    SELECT type
    FROM sets
    WHERE name = 'From the Vault: Lore'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM set_translations AS t
    WHERE t.setCode = s.code
)
ORDER BY s.releaseDate;

WITH newest AS (
    SELECT MAX(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER)) AS year
    FROM cards
    WHERE name = 'Aven Mindcensor'
      AND frameVersion GLOB '[0-9]*'
),
latest_release AS (
    SELECT MAX(s.releaseDate) AS releaseDate
    FROM cards c
    JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
    CROSS JOIN newest n
    WHERE c.name = 'Aven Mindcensor'
      AND CAST(c.frameVersion AS INTEGER) = n.year
)
SELECT DISTINCT s.name AS set_name, s.releaseDate
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
CROSS JOIN newest n
CROSS JOIN latest_release lr
WHERE c.name = 'Aven Mindcensor'
  AND CAST(c.frameVersion AS INTEGER) = n.year
  AND s.releaseDate = lr.releaseDate;

SELECT s.code, s.releaseDate
FROM sets AS s
WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2020-01-01'
  AND s.releaseDate < '2021-01-01'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM set_translations AS st
    WHERE st.setCode = s.code
      AND lower(st.language) = 'es'
  )
ORDER BY s.releaseDate, s.code;

SELECT SUM(convertedManaCost) AS total
FROM cards
WHERE artist = 'Rob Alexander'
  AND originalReleaseDate IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(substr(originalReleaseDate, 1, instr(originalReleaseDate, '/') - 1) AS INTEGER) = 2013;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(language_count), 2) AS average_languages
FROM (
  SELECT s.code, COUNT(DISTINCT st.language) AS language_count
  FROM sets AS s
  LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st ON st.setCode = s.code
  WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2016-01-01'
    AND s.releaseDate < '2017-01-01'
  GROUP BY s.code
);

WITH block_stats AS (
    SELECT
        s.block,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM set_translations st
                WHERE st.setCode = s.code
                  AND st.translation IS NOT NULL
                  AND TRIM(st.translation) <> ''
            ) THEN s.code
        END) AS translated_sets,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN s.type = 'expansion' THEN COALESCE(s.baseSetSize, 0)
            ELSE 0
        END) AS base_set_cards
    FROM sets s
    WHERE s.block IN ('Masques', 'Mirage')
    GROUP BY s.block
)
SELECT block, translated_sets, base_set_cards
FROM block_stats
ORDER BY CASE block WHEN 'Masques' THEN 1 WHEN 'Mirage' THEN 2 END;

WITH set_languages AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT language
  FROM set_translations
  WHERE language IS NOT NULL
),
translated_printings AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fd.language, fd.uuid
  FROM foreign_data AS fd
  JOIN set_languages AS sl ON sl.language = fd.language
  WHERE fd.flavorText IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(fd.flavorText) <> ''
),
counts AS (
  SELECT sl.language, COUNT(tp.uuid) AS printing_count
  FROM set_languages AS sl
  LEFT JOIN translated_printings AS tp
    ON tp.language = sl.language
  GROUP BY sl.language
)
SELECT language, printing_count
FROM counts
WHERE printing_count = (SELECT MIN(printing_count) FROM counts)
ORDER BY language;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS creature_card_count
FROM cards c
WHERE c.type LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND c.power GLOB '[0-9]*'
  AND CAST(c.power AS INTEGER) >= 10
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM set_translations st
    WHERE st.language = 'French'
      AND instr(',' || c.printings || ',', ',' || st.setCode || ',') > 0
  );

WITH ranked_creatures AS (
    SELECT scryfallOracleId, convertedManaCost
    FROM cards
    WHERE edhrecRank BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
      AND types LIKE '%Creature%'
      AND scryfallOracleId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY scryfallOracleId
),
banned AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.scryfallOracleId
    FROM cards c
    JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
    WHERE LOWER(l.status) = 'banned'
      AND c.scryfallOracleId IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.convertedManaCost), 1) AS avg_mana_value
FROM ranked_creatures r
JOIN banned b USING (scryfallOracleId);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS printing_count
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
WHERE c.originalReleaseDate >= '2014-01-01'
  AND c.originalReleaseDate < '2015-01-01'
  AND s.mtgoCode IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.mtgoCode) <> '';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS count
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
JOIN foreign_data f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'
  AND f.language = 'Italian'
  AND f.text IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(f.text) <> '';

SELECT s.id, s.name,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM cards c
        WHERE c.setCode = s.code
          AND COALESCE(c.isOnlineOnly, 0) = 0) AS total_card_count,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT st.language)
        FROM set_translations st
        WHERE st.setCode = s.code) AS official_language_count
FROM sets s
WHERE s.type = 'commander'
  AND s.releaseDate >= '2020-01-01'
  AND s.releaseDate < '2021-01-01'
ORDER BY total_card_count DESC, s.id ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fd.language) AS foreign_language_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Swamp'
  AND fd.language IS NOT NULL;

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
WHERE p.Title = 'Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation';

SELECT
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2010' AND Name = 'Student' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2011' AND Name = 'Student' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    AS percentage_point_difference
FROM badges
WHERE strftime('%Y', Date) IN ('2010', '2011');

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Tags LIKE '%<r>%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM posts
WHERE OwnerDisplayName = 'Community'
   OR OwnerUserId IN (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'Community');

SELECT p.Id, u.DisplayName
FROM posts AS p
LEFT JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.CreaionDate >= '2010-01-01'
  AND p.CreaionDate < '2011-01-01'
ORDER BY p.FavoriteCount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.ViewCount, u.DisplayName
FROM posts AS p
LEFT JOIN users AS u ON p.LastEditorUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Computer game datasets';

SELECT c.Text AS comment_text, u.DisplayName AS author_display_name
FROM comments AS c
JOIN posts AS p ON p.Id = c.PostId
LEFT JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = c.UserId
WHERE p.Title = 'Analysing wind data with R'
ORDER BY c.CreationDate DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH highest AS (
    SELECT MAX(Reputation) AS max_rep
    FROM users
),
top_users AS (
    SELECT Id
    FROM users
    WHERE Reputation = (SELECT max_rep FROM highest)
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.Score > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM posts p
JOIN top_users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS zero_score_comment_count
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON p.Id = c.PostId
WHERE c.Score = 0
  AND c.PostId IN (
      SELECT PostId
      FROM comments
      WHERE PostId IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY PostId
      HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
  );

SELECT SUM(u.Reputation) AS total_reputation
FROM users AS u
WHERE u.Location LIKE '%United Kingdom%'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(u.Age), 2) AS average_age
FROM comments AS c
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = c.UserId
WHERE c.Text LIKE '%http://%';

WITH organizer_earns AS (
  SELECT UserId, MIN(Date) AS organizer_date
  FROM badges
  WHERE Name = 'Organizer'
  GROUP BY UserId
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT o.UserId, o.organizer_date
  FROM organizer_earns o
  JOIN users u ON u.Id = o.UserId
  WHERE u.Location LIKE '%Germany%'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM eligible e
WHERE (
  SELECT COUNT(*)
  FROM badges b
  WHERE b.UserId = e.UserId
    AND b.Date < e.organizer_date
) >= 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM users AS u
WHERE lower(trim(u.Location)) = 'india'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
      AND p.CreaionDate >= '2010-01-01'
      AND p.CreaionDate < '2011-01-01'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM posts AS earlier
        WHERE earlier.OwnerUserId = p.OwnerUserId
          AND (
            earlier.CreaionDate < p.CreaionDate
            OR (earlier.CreaionDate = p.CreaionDate AND earlier.Id < p.Id)
          )
      )
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(u.Reputation)) AS average_reputation
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.Score < 20
  AND p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%';

SELECT SUM(u.Reputation)
FROM users u
WHERE u.Id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.OwnerUserId
    FROM posts p
    WHERE p.Score = 10
      AND p.OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL
      AND p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%'
);

SELECT SUM(u.Reputation) AS combined_reputation
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%'
  AND p.LasActivityDate >= '2014-08-27'
  AND p.LasActivityDate < '2014-08-28';

WITH germany_badges AS (
    SELECT u.Id, u.DisplayName, COUNT(b.Id) AS badge_total
    FROM users AS u
    JOIN badges AS b ON b.UserId = u.Id
    WHERE u.Location LIKE '%Germany%'
    GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
)
SELECT DisplayName, badge_total
FROM germany_badges
WHERE badge_total = (
    SELECT MAX(badge_total)
    FROM germany_badges
    WHERE badge_total < (SELECT MAX(badge_total) FROM germany_badges)
)
ORDER BY DisplayName;

SELECT Age
FROM users
WHERE (lower(Location) = 'york' OR lower(Location) LIKE 'york, united kingdom%')
  AND Reputation = (
    SELECT MAX(Reputation)
    FROM users
    WHERE lower(Location) = 'york' OR lower(Location) LIKE 'york, united kingdom%'
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.UserId) AS user_count
FROM badges AS b
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = b.UserId
WHERE b.Name = 'Yearling'
  AND b.Date < '2014-01-01'
  AND u.Location = 'India';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.DisplayName) AS distinct_display_names
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON u.Id = b.UserId
WHERE b.Name = 'Supporter'
  AND u.Age BETWEEN 19 AND 65;

SELECT Id
FROM users
WHERE DisplayName = 'Michael'
ORDER BY CreationDate DESC, Id ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(CAST(p.OwnerUserId AS TEXT), p.OwnerDisplayName)) AS user_count
FROM votes AS v
JOIN posts AS p ON p.Id = v.PostId
WHERE v.BountyAmount >= 30
  AND v.CreationDate >= '2010-01-01'
  AND v.CreationDate < '2011-01-01'
  AND COALESCE(CAST(p.OwnerUserId AS TEXT), p.OwnerDisplayName) IS NOT NULL;

WITH active_users AS (
    SELECT OwnerUserId
    FROM posts
    WHERE CreaionDate >= '2012-01-01'
      AND CreaionDate < '2013-01-01'
      AND OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY OwnerUserId
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
),
user_upvotes AS (
    SELECT UserId, COUNT(*) AS upvote_count
    FROM votes
    WHERE VoteTypeId = 2
      AND UserId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY UserId
)
SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(uu.upvote_count, 0)), 2) AS avg_upvotes_cast,
    ROUND(AVG(u.Age), 2) AS avg_age
FROM active_users AS a
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = a.OwnerUserId
LEFT JOIN user_upvotes AS uu ON uu.UserId = u.Id;

WITH RECURSIVE months(month_num) AS (
  SELECT 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT month_num + 1 FROM months WHERE month_num < 12
),
monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT CAST(strftime('%m', pl.CreationDate) AS INTEGER) AS month_num,
         COUNT(DISTINCT pl.PostId) AS post_count
  FROM postLinks AS pl
  JOIN posts AS p ON p.Id = pl.PostId
  WHERE pl.CreationDate >= '2010-01-01'
    AND pl.CreationDate < '2011-01-01'
    AND p.AnswerCount <= 2
  GROUP BY CAST(strftime('%m', pl.CreationDate) AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(mc.post_count, 0)), 2) AS average_posts_per_month
FROM months AS m
LEFT JOIN monthly_counts AS mc ON mc.month_num = m.month_num;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN u.Reputation < 1000 OR u.Reputation IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.CreaionDate >= '2010-01-01'
  AND p.CreaionDate < '2011-01-01'
  AND p.Score > 5;

WITH edit_comments AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(NULLIF(u.DisplayName, ''), ph.UserDisplayName) AS editor_display_name,
        COUNT(*) AS edit_comment_count
    FROM postHistory AS ph
    LEFT JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = ph.UserId
    JOIN posts AS p ON p.Id = ph.PostId
    WHERE p.Title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?'
      AND ph.PostHistoryTypeId IN (4, 5)
      AND ph.Comment IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(ph.Comment) <> ''
    GROUP BY ph.UserId, editor_display_name
)
SELECT editor_display_name, edit_comment_count
FROM edit_comments
WHERE edit_comment_count = (SELECT MAX(edit_comment_count) FROM edit_comments)
ORDER BY editor_display_name;

WITH annual AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) AS yr,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4)
),
changes AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        100.0 * (
            SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '2013' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END)
            - SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '2012' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END)
        ) / SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '2012' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END)
            AS increase_percentage
    FROM annual
    GROUP BY Segment
),
extremes AS (
    SELECT MAX(increase_percentage) AS highest, MIN(increase_percentage) AS lowest
    FROM changes
)
SELECT
    ch.Segment,
    ROUND(ch.increase_percentage, 2) AS increase_percentage
FROM changes AS ch
CROSS JOIN extremes AS e
WHERE ch.increase_percentage = e.highest
   OR ch.increase_percentage = e.lowest
ORDER BY ch.increase_percentage DESC, ch.Segment;

SELECT ROUND(
    (SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2013%' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) -
     SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2012%' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)) /
    SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2012%' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END),
    4
) AS relative_change
FROM yearmonth
WHERE CustomerID = (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-25'
      AND Price = 634.8
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS customer_count
FROM customers AS c
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    WHERE y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
      AND y.Date LIKE '2012%'
      AND y.Consumption > 0
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    WHERE y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
      AND y.Date LIKE '2013%'
      AND y.Consumption > 0
  );

WITH active_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date >= '2012-01-01'
      AND Date < '2013-01-01'
),
customer_consumption AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date >= '201201'
      AND Date < '201301'
    GROUP BY CustomerID
)
SELECT c.Segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM active_customers a
JOIN customer_consumption cc ON cc.CustomerID = a.CustomerID
JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = a.CustomerID
WHERE cc.total_consumption < 30000
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY c.Segment;

SELECT c.Segment, COUNT(DISTINCT y.CustomerID) AS customer_count
FROM customers AS c
JOIN yearmonth AS y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE y.Date >= '201301'
  AND y.Date < '201401'
  AND y.Consumption > 0
GROUP BY c.Segment;

SELECT CAST(
    (julianday(MAX(datetime(t.Date || ' ' || t.Time))) -
     julianday(MIN(datetime(t.Date || ' ' || t.Time))) ) * 1440
    AS INTEGER
) AS elapsed_minutes
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN gasstations AS g
    ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE g.Country = 'CZE'
  AND t.Price > 1000;

SELECT c.Currency, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customers AS c
JOIN (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201311'
      AND Consumption > 0
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT Date) = 11
) AS active ON active.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Currency;

SELECT c.Currency,
       ROUND(AVG(q.quarter_total), 2) AS avg_quarter_consumption
FROM (
    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Consumption) AS quarter_total
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date IN ('201304', '201305', '201306')
    GROUP BY CustomerID
) AS q
JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = q.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency IN ('EUR', 'CZK')
GROUP BY c.Currency;

WITH monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT
        substr(Date, 1, 4) AS year,
        Date,
        SUM(Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE substr(Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY Date
),
yearly_peaks AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(total_consumption) AS peak_consumption
    FROM monthly_totals
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT ROUND(
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN peak_consumption END) -
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN peak_consumption END)
) AS difference_in_consumption
FROM yearly_peaks;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM (
    SELECT c.CustomerID
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearmonth AS y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM'
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date >= '2013-01'
      AND y.Date < '2014-01'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID
    HAVING SUM(y.Consumption) > 1000000
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID)
FROM customers AS c
JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
JOIN products AS p ON p.ProductID = t.ProductID
WHERE c.Segment = 'SME'
  AND t.Date >= '2013-02-01'
  AND t.Date < '2013-03-01'
  AND p.Description IN ('Special', 'Super', 'Natural', 'Mix', 'Natural +', 'Natural Plus');

WITH away_wins AS (
    SELECT t.team_long_name AS away_team, COUNT(*) AS win_count
    FROM "Match" AS m
    JOIN League AS l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Team AS t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
    WHERE l.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
      AND m.season = '2009/2010'
      AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal
    GROUP BY t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name
)
SELECT away_team
FROM away_wins
WHERE win_count = (SELECT MAX(win_count) FROM away_wins);

SELECT DISTINCT t.team_long_name
FROM Team AS t
JOIN Team_Attributes AS ta
  ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE ta.date >= '2012-01-01'
  AND ta.date < '2013-01-01'
  AND ta.buildUpPlayPassing > (
    SELECT AVG(buildUpPlayPassing)
    FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE date >= '2012-01-01'
      AND date < '2013-01-01'

SELECT
    p.player_api_id,
    p.player_name,
    AVG(pa.heading_accuracy) AS mean_heading_accuracy
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
    ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY mean_heading_accuracy DESC, p.player_api_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT l.name
FROM League AS l
JOIN "Match" AS m ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2009/2010'
GROUP BY l.id, l.name
HAVING AVG(m.home_team_goal) > AVG(m.away_team_goal);

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT
        p.player_name,
        pa.overall_rating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY p.player_api_id
            ORDER BY pa.date DESC, pa.id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa
        ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name IN ('Ariel Borysiuk', 'Paulin Puel')
),
ratings AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk' THEN overall_rating END) AS ariel_rating,
        MAX(CASE WHEN player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN overall_rating END) AS paulin_rating
    FROM latest
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT ROUND(
    (ariel_rating - paulin_rating) * 100.0 / paulin_rating,
    2
) AS percentage_higher
FROM ratings;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM Player_Attributes pa
            WHERE pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
              AND pa.overall_rating > 70
        ) THEN p.player_api_id
    END) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM Player p
WHERE p.height < 180;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.height), 2) AS average_height_cm
FROM "Match" AS m
JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = m.home_player_3
WHERE p.height > 180;

WITH young AS (
    SELECT p.player_api_id
    FROM Player p
    WHERE p.birthday >= '1991-01-01'
),
rated AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        y.player_api_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(pa.defensive_work_rate)) = 'high' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            OVER (PARTITION BY y.player_api_id) AS ever_high
    FROM young y
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa
        ON pa.player_api_id = y.player_api_id
    WHERE pa.defensive_work_rate IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(ever_high) / COUNT(*), 2) AS high_share_percentage
FROM rated;

    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        overall_rating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC

    WHERE date <= '2010-12-31'

shortlisted AS (

    WHERE rn = 1

appearances AS (

        s.player_api_id,

            CASE WHEN m.home_player_5 = s.player_api_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN m.home_player_6 = s.player_api_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN m.home_player_7 = s.player_api_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN m.home_player_8 = s.player_api_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN m.home_player_9 = s.player_api_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +

    FROM shortlisted s
    JOIN Match m
      ON m.season = '2010/2011'
    GROUP BY s.player_api_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(match_count), 2) AS average_matches
FROM appearances;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.height), 2) AS average_height_cm
FROM Player AS p
JOIN (
    SELECT player_api_id, defensive_work_rate,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY player_api_id
               ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes
) AS latest
    ON latest.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE latest.rn = 1
  AND LOWER(TRIM(latest.defensive_work_rate)) <> 'medium';

WITH risky_teams AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT team_api_id
    FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Risky'
),
current_attributes AS (
    SELECT
        team_api_id,
        chanceCreationPassing,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY team_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE date <= '2014-09-19'
)
SELECT
    t.team_short_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_api_id) AS club_count,
    ROUND(AVG(ca.chanceCreationPassing), 1) AS average_chance_creation_passing_risk
FROM risky_teams AS r
JOIN Team AS t
    ON t.team_api_id = r.team_api_id
JOIN current_attributes AS ca
    ON ca.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
   AND ca.rn = 1
GROUP BY t.team_short_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_api_id) > 1
ORDER BY average_chance_creation_passing_risk DESC, t.team_short_name ASC;

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        defensive_work_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE defensive_work_rate IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.height), 2) AS average_height_cm
FROM Player AS p
JOIN latest AS l
    ON l.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
   AND l.rn = 1
WHERE l.defensive_work_rate = 'medium'
  AND p.birthday >= '1990-01-01'
  AND p.birthday < '1996-01-01'
  AND p.height IS NOT NULL;

FROM Player AS p
WHERE EXISTS (

SELECT ta.buildUpPlayDribblingClass
FROM Team AS t
JOIN Team_Attributes AS ta ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'Portsmouth'
  AND t.team_short_name = 'POR'
  AND ta.date LIKE '2015-09-10%';

WITH qualifying_matches AS (
    SELECT
        m.id AS match_id,
        m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        m.date
    FROM "Match" AS m
    WHERE m.home_team_goal - m.away_team_goal >= 3
),
rated_matches AS (
    SELECT
        q.match_id,
        q.team_api_id,
        (
            SELECT ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
            FROM Team_Attributes AS ta
            WHERE ta.team_api_id = q.team_api_id
              AND ta.date <= q.date
            ORDER BY ta.date DESC, ta.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS speed_class
    FROM qualifying_matches AS q
),
club_counts AS (
    SELECT
        t.id AS team_id,
        t.team_long_name,
        t.team_short_name,
        COUNT(*) AS home_win_count
    FROM rated_matches AS r
    JOIN Team AS t
      ON t.team_api_id = r.team_api_id
    WHERE r.speed_class = 'Fast'
    GROUP BY t.id, t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name
)
SELECT
    team_long_name,
    team_short_name,
    home_win_count
FROM club_counts
WHERE home_win_count = (SELECT MAX(home_win_count) FROM club_counts)
ORDER BY team_long_name, team_id;

  SELECT p.player_api_id, COALESCE(SUM(m.home_team_goal), 0) AS total_home_goals
  FROM Player p
  LEFT JOIN "Match" m ON m.home_player_3 = p.player_api_id
  GROUP BY p.player_api_id

SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_home_goals), 2) AS average_total_home_goals
FROM player_totals;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        preferred_foot,
        attacking_work_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE date <= '2015-01-01'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS player_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
  AND preferred_foot = 'left'
  AND attacking_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium');

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        preferred_foot,
        attacking_work_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes
),
eligible AS (
    SELECT preferred_foot, attacking_work_rate
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
      AND preferred_foot = 'left'
      AND attacking_work_rate IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(attacking_work_rate) <> ''
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(attacking_work_rate) = 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    1
) AS percentage
FROM eligible;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, player_name
    FROM Player
    WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%'
      AND birthday > '1990-12-31'
),
appearances AS (
    SELECT
        p.player_api_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS matches_played
    FROM eligible AS p
    LEFT JOIN "Match" AS m
        ON m.season = '2015/2016'
       AND (
           p.player_api_id IN (
               m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3,
               m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6,
               m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9,
               m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
               m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3,
               m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6,
               m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9,
               m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
           )
       )
    GROUP BY p.player_api_id
)
SELECT e.player_name, a.matches_played
FROM eligible AS e
JOIN appearances AS a
    ON e.player_api_id = a.player_api_id
ORDER BY e.player_name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS player_count
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE date >= '2007-02-22'
  AND date <= '2007-08-30'
  AND jumping >= 80;

SELECT ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS ta
JOIN Team AS t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'
  AND ta.date <= (
    SELECT MAX(m.date)
    FROM Match AS m
    WHERE m.season = '2012/2013'
      AND (m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id OR m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id)
  )
ORDER BY ta.date DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH lowest_salary_district AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district)
),
oldest_female_client AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_date
    FROM client c
    JOIN lowest_salary_district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
    ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT dp.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) - MIN(A11) FROM district) AS salary_difference
FROM oldest_female_client c
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id;

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29';

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS male_percentage
FROM client AS c
JOIN district AS d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
  AND CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) = (
      SELECT MAX(CAST(A4 AS INTEGER))
      FROM district
      WHERE A3 = 'south Bohemia'
  );

SELECT 100.0 * (ending.balance - starting.balance) / starting.balance AS percentage_increase
FROM loan AS l
JOIN trans AS starting
  ON starting.account_id = l.account_id
 AND starting.date = '1993-03-22'
JOIN trans AS ending
  ON ending.account_id = l.account_id
 AND ending.date = '1998-12-27'
WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05';

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE a.date >= '1995-01-01'
  AND a.date < '2001-01-01'
  AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia';

SELECT d.A2 AS district,
       ROUND((d.A13 - d.A12) * 100.0 / d.A12, 2) AS percentage_change
FROM district AS d
WHERE d.A12 IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM account AS a
      JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
      WHERE a.district_id = d.district_id
        AND l.status = 'D'
  )
ORDER BY d.A2;

SELECT dp.type, COUNT(DISTINCT dp.account_id) AS account_count
FROM disp AS dp
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE dp.type <> 'OWNER'
  AND d.A11 > 8000
  AND d.A11 <= 9000
GROUP BY dp.type;

SELECT
  100.0 * (
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', date) = '1997' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) -
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', date) = '1996' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
  ) /
  SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', date) = '1996' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS percentage_growth
FROM loan
WHERE strftime('%Y', date) IN ('1996', '1997')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM disp
    JOIN client USING (client_id)
    WHERE disp.account_id = loan.account_id
      AND client.gender = 'M'
  );

SELECT a.frequency AS statement_frequency, o.k_symbol AS payment_purpose_code
FROM account AS a
JOIN "order" AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_id = 3
GROUP BY a.frequency, o.k_symbol
HAVING SUM(o.amount) = 3539;

WITH first_month AS (
  SELECT date(MIN(date), 'start of month') AS month_start
  FROM account
),
opened_districts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
  FROM account AS a
  CROSS JOIN first_month AS f
  WHERE date(a.date, 'start of month') = f.month_start
)
SELECT d.A2 AS district, d.A4 AS population
FROM district AS d
JOIN opened_districts AS o ON o.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) = (
  SELECT MAX(CAST(d2.A4 AS INTEGER))
  FROM district AS d2
  JOIN opened_districts AS o2 ON o2.district_id = d2.district_id
);

WITH top_districts AS (
  SELECT district_id, A2 AS district_name
  FROM district
  ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
  LIMIT 5
),
district_averages AS (
  SELECT
    td.district_id,
    td.district_name,
    ROUND(
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('C', 'D') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) * 1.0
      / COUNT(a.account_id)
    ) AS average_active_loan_per_account
  FROM top_districts td
  JOIN account a ON a.district_id = td.district_id
  LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  GROUP BY td.district_id, td.district_name
)
SELECT district_name, average_active_loan_per_account
FROM district_averages
WHERE average_active_loan_per_account = (
  SELECT MAX(average_active_loan_per_account)
  FROM district_averages
)
ORDER BY district_name;

WITH regional_totals AS (
  SELECT d.A3 AS region, SUM(l.amount) AS total_amount
  FROM loan AS l
  JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  WHERE date(l.date) <= date('1995-12-31')
    AND date(l.date, '+' || l.duration || ' months') >= date('1995-12-31')
  GROUP BY d.A3
)
SELECT region, total_amount
FROM regional_totals
WHERE total_amount = (SELECT MAX(total_amount) FROM regional_totals);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(loan_count * 1.0), 2) AS average_loans_per_account
FROM (
  SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count
  FROM disp AS d
  JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
  JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
  LEFT JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
    AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  GROUP BY a.account_id
);

WITH loan_totals AS (
    SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS total_borrowed
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
counterparties AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT counterparty_account) AS counterparty_count
    FROM (
        SELECT account_id, account AS counterparty_account
        FROM trans
        WHERE type = 'PRIJEM' AND bank IS NOT NULL AND account IS NOT NULL

        UNION

        SELECT account_id, account AS counterparty_account
        FROM trans
        WHERE type = 'VYDAJ' AND bank IS NOT NULL AND account IS NOT NULL
    )
    GROUP BY account_id
),
borrowing_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id,
           a.date AS opening_date,
           lt.total_borrowed,
           COALESCE(cp.counterparty_count, 0) AS counterparty_count,
           d.A2 AS home_district,
           CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS district_population
    FROM account a
    JOIN district branch ON branch.district_id = a.district_id
    JOIN loan_totals lt ON lt.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN disp dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    LEFT JOIN counterparties cp ON cp.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE branch.A2 = 'Prachatice'
)
SELECT account_id,
       opening_date,
       total_borrowed,
       counterparty_count,
       home_district,
       district_population,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY district_population DESC) AS population_rank
FROM borrowing_accounts
ORDER BY district_population DESC, account_id;

WITH avg_balance AS (
    SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.gender,
        d.district_id,
        CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS inhabitants,
        d.A11 AS salary,
        d.A10 AS urban_ratio
    FROM card AS ca
    JOIN disp AS dp
        ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id
       AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client AS c
        ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    JOIN account AS a
        ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    JOIN avg_balance AS ab
        ON ab.account_id = a.account_id
       AND ab.avg_balance > 1000
    JOIN district AS d
        ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE ca.type = 'gold'
      AND CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) > 100000
),
gender_summary AS (
    SELECT
        gender,
        COUNT(*) AS district_count,
        MAX(inhabitants) AS max_inhabitants,
        ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS avg_salary,
        ROUND(AVG(urban_ratio), 2) AS avg_urban_ratio
    FROM qualifying_districts
    GROUP BY gender
)
SELECT
    CASE s.gender WHEN 'F' THEN 'women' WHEN 'M' THEN 'men' ELSE s.gender END AS gender,
    s.district_count,
    q.district_id,
    q.inhabitants,
    s.avg_salary,
    s.avg_urban_ratio
FROM gender_summary AS s
JOIN qualifying_districts AS q
    ON q.gender = s.gender
   AND q.inhabitants = s.max_inhabitants
ORDER BY CASE s.gender WHEN 'F' THEN 0 WHEN 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
         q.district_id;

WITH pair_totals AS (
    SELECT
        t.bank AS recipient_bank_code,
        t.account AS recipient_counter_account,
        COUNT(*) AS outgoing_payment_count,
        SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount_paid
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a
        ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    JOIN district AS d
        ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
      AND t.date >= '1998-01-01'
      AND t.date < '1999-01-01'
      AND CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) >= 250000
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM disp AS owner_disp
          JOIN card AS c
              ON c.disp_id = owner_disp.disp_id
          WHERE owner_disp.account_id = a.account_id
            AND owner_disp.type = 'OWNER'
            AND c.type = 'gold'
      )
    GROUP BY t.bank, t.account
),
ranked_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        recipient_bank_code,
        recipient_counter_account,
        outgoing_payment_count,
        total_amount_paid,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC) AS amount_rank
    FROM pair_totals
)
SELECT
    recipient_bank_code,
    recipient_counter_account,
    outgoing_payment_count,
    total_amount_paid
FROM ranked_pairs
WHERE amount_rank = 1;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END)
    / SUM(t.amount),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM trans AS t
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Pisek'
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.k_symbol IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(t.k_symbol) <> '';

WITH eligible_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.district_id
    FROM client AS c
    JOIN disp AS dp
        ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM card AS ca
          WHERE ca.disp_id = dp.disp_id
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM loan AS lo
          WHERE lo.account_id = dp.account_id
      )
)
SELECT
    d.A3 AS region,
    ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS avg_district_salary,
    ROUND(AVG(d.A13), 2) AS avg_unemployment_rate_1996,
    (
        SELECT d2.A2
        FROM district AS d2
        JOIN eligible_districts AS ed2
            ON ed2.district_id = d2.district_id
        WHERE d2.A3 = d.A3
        ORDER BY d2.A9 DESC, d2.A2 ASC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS most_populous_district
FROM district AS d
JOIN eligible_districts AS ed
    ON ed.district_id = d.district_id
GROUP BY d.A3;

WITH district_crimes AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A3 AS region,
        CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS inhabitants,
        COUNT(t.trans_id) AS crimes_1996
    FROM district AS d
    LEFT JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    LEFT JOIN trans AS t
        ON t.account_id = a.account_id
       AND t.date >= '1996-01-01'
       AND t.date < '1997-01-01'
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2, d.A3, d.A4
),
ranked_central AS (
    SELECT
        district_name,
        inhabitants,
        crimes_1996,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, lower(district_name) ASC
        ) AS rank
    FROM district_crimes
    WHERE region = 'central Bohemia'
),
averages AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT AVG(crimes_1996)
         FROM ranked_central
         WHERE rank <= 3) AS top_three_average,
        (SELECT AVG(crimes_1996)
         FROM district_crimes) AS overall_average
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN r.rank = 1 THEN r.district_name END) AS first_district,
    MAX(CASE WHEN r.rank = 1 THEN r.crimes_1996 END) AS first_district_crimes_1996,
    MAX(CASE WHEN r.rank = 2 THEN r.district_name END) AS second_district,
    MAX(CASE WHEN r.rank = 2 THEN r.crimes_1996 END) AS second_district_crimes_1996,
    MAX(CASE WHEN r.rank = 3 THEN r.district_name END) AS third_district,
    MAX(CASE WHEN r.rank = 3 THEN r.crimes_1996 END) AS third_district_crimes_1996,
    ROUND(a.top_three_average, 2) AS top_three_average_crimes_1996,
    ROUND(a.overall_average, 2) AS overall_average_crimes_1996,
    ROUND(a.top_three_average - a.overall_average, 2) AS average_difference
FROM ranked_central AS r
CROSS JOIN averages AS a
WHERE r.rank <= 3;

WITH region_districts AS (
    SELECT district_id, A2 AS district_name
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = (SELECT A3 FROM district WHERE A2 = 'Litomerice')
),
opened_accounts AS (
    SELECT account_id, district_id
    FROM account
    WHERE date >= '1996-01-01'
      AND date < '1997-01-01'
),
ranked_transactions AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        t.balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY t.account_id
            ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN opened_accounts AS oa ON oa.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.date <= '1996-12-31'
),
account_balances AS (
    SELECT oa.account_id, oa.district_id, rt.balance
    FROM opened_accounts AS oa
    JOIN ranked_transactions AS rt
      ON rt.account_id = oa.account_id
     AND rt.rn = 1
),
district_stats AS (
    SELECT
        rd.district_id,
        rd.district_name,
        COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened,
        ROUND(AVG(ab.balance), 2) AS avg_end_of_1996_balance
    FROM region_districts AS rd
    JOIN account_balances AS ab ON ab.district_id = rd.district_id
    GROUP BY rd.district_id, rd.district_name
),
region_avg AS (
    SELECT ROUND(AVG(balance), 2) AS region_avg_end_of_1996_balance
    FROM account_balances
)
SELECT
    ds.district_name,
    ds.accounts_opened,
    ds.avg_end_of_1996_balance,
    ra.region_avg_end_of_1996_balance,
    (
        SELECT district_name
        FROM district_stats
        ORDER BY avg_end_of_1996_balance DESC, district_name ASC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS highest_avg_balance_district
FROM district_stats AS ds
CROSS JOIN region_avg AS ra
ORDER BY ds.district_name;

WITH ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT
        l.loan_id,
        l.amount,
        a.district_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY l.amount DESC, l.loan_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a
        ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.duration = 24
      AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
),
top_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        d.district_id,
        d.A4 AS inhabitants,
        d.A11 AS average_salary
    FROM ranked_loans AS r
    JOIN district AS d
        ON d.district_id = r.district_id
    WHERE r.rn <= 10
)
SELECT
    inhabitants AS most_populous_district_inhabitants,
    ROUND(AVG(average_salary), 2) AS average_salary_across_districts
FROM top_districts
WHERE district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM top_districts
    ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC
    LIMIT 1
);

WITH client_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE client_id = 3541
),
account_transactions AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
district_ranks AS (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        A2,
        A3,
        A8,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY A3 ORDER BY A8 DESC) AS population_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A3 ORDER BY A8 DESC, district_id) AS region_pop_order
    FROM district
),
region_clients AS (
    SELECT d.A3, COUNT(*) AS client_count
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
)
SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.date AS date_opened,
    a.frequency,
    account_district.A2 AS district_name,
    account_district.A3 AS region,
    CASE
        WHEN account_district.district_id = home_client.district_id THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS home_district,
    account_district.A11 AS average_salary,
    COALESCE(l.status, 'none') AS loan_status,
    COALESCE(l.amount, 0) AS loan_amount,
    COALESCE(t.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    COALESCE(t.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
    COALESCE(t.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
    COALESCE(t.total_income, 0) - COALESCE(t.total_expense, 0) AS net_balance,
    rc.client_count AS region_client_count,
    most_populous.A2 AS most_populous_district,
    most_populous.A8 AS most_populous_district_inhabitants,
    account_rank.population_rank AS population_rank
FROM client_accounts ca
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ca.account_id
JOIN district account_district ON account_district.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN client home_client ON home_client.client_id = 3541
LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN account_transactions t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN region_clients rc ON rc.A3 = account_district.A3
JOIN district_ranks account_rank ON account_rank.district_id = account_district.district_id
JOIN district_ranks most_populous
    ON most_populous.A3 = account_district.A3
    AND most_populous.region_pop_order = 1
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, a.account_id ASC;

WITH account_lending AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.district_id,
        a.date,
        COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS lent
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d
        ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    LEFT JOIN loan AS l
        ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE d.A3 = 'central Bohemia'
      AND a.date >= '1996-01-01'
    GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, a.date
),
district_year AS (
    SELECT
        strftime('%Y', date) AS year,
        district_id,
        SUM(lent) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS lent_per_account
    FROM account_lending
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y', date), district_id
)
SELECT
    strftime('%Y', al.date) AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened,
    SUM(al.lent) AS total_amount_lent,
    ROUND(AVG(dy.lent_per_account), 2) AS avg_district_amount_lent_per_account
FROM account_lending AS al
JOIN district_year AS dy
    ON dy.year = strftime('%Y', al.date)
   AND dy.district_id = al.district_id
GROUP BY strftime('%Y', al.date)
ORDER BY year;

WITH ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT
        l.loan_id,
        l.account_id,
        l.date AS approval_date,
        l.amount AS approved_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY l.amount DESC, l.date ASC) AS loan_rank
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.duration = 24
      AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
)
SELECT
    d.A2 AS district,
    rl.approved_amount,
    rl.approval_date,
    (
        SELECT t.balance
        FROM trans AS t
        WHERE t.account_id = rl.account_id
          AND date(t.date) = date(rl.approval_date)
        ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS approval_day_end_balance
FROM ranked_loans AS rl
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = rl.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE rl.loan_rank <= 10
ORDER BY rl.approved_amount DESC, rl.approval_date ASC;

WITH card_clients AS (
    SELECT
        c.client_id,
        c.gender,
        c.birth_date,
        ca.card_id,
        ca.type AS card_type,
        CAST(strftime('%Y', ca.issued) AS INTEGER)
            - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) AS age_at_issue,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A11 AS district_average_salary,
        dp.account_id
    FROM card AS ca
    JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id
    JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    WHERE ca.issued >= '1994-01-01'
      AND ca.issued < '1995-01-01'
),
client_loans AS (
    SELECT
        cc.client_id,
        cc.gender,
        cc.birth_date,
        cc.card_id,
        cc.card_type,
        cc.age_at_issue,
        cc.district_name,
        cc.district_average_salary,
        COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS number_of_loans,
        COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT l.amount), 0) AS total_amount_borrowed
    FROM card_clients AS cc
    LEFT JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = cc.account_id
    GROUP BY
        cc.client_id, cc.gender, cc.birth_date, cc.card_id, cc.card_type,
        cc.age_at_issue, cc.district_name, cc.district_average_salary
)
SELECT
    client_id,
    gender,
    birth_date,
    card_type,
    age_at_issue,
    number_of_loans,
    total_amount_borrowed,
    CASE
        WHEN number_of_loans > 0 AND age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower'
        WHEN number_of_loans > 0 AND age_at_issue >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower'
        ELSE 'Non-borrower'
    END AS borrower_classification,
    district_name,
    district_average_salary,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY gender ORDER BY age_at_issue) AS age_rank_within_gender
FROM client_loans
ORDER BY client_id;

SELECT d.A2 AS branch, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM district AS d
JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'north Moravia'
  AND t.date <= '1998-10-14'
  AND t.k_symbol IS NULL
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
    t.bank AS bank_code,
    t.account AS account_number,
    COUNT(*) AS outgoing_payment_count,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount_paid
FROM loan AS l
JOIN disp AS d
    ON d.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN trans AS t
    ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE l.loan_id = 5999
  AND l.date = '1996-01-03'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date < '1996-01-03'
GROUP BY t.bank, t.account
ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id)
FROM account AS a
JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 1
  AND a.date <= '1995-12-31'
  AND l.date <= '1995-12-31'
  AND l.status IN ('C', 'D');

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN k_symbol = 'UROK' THEN amount
                         WHEN k_symbol = 'SANKC. UROK' THEN -amount
                         ELSE 0 END), 0) AS net_interest_czk
FROM trans
WHERE account_id = (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE client_id = 2823
)
  AND date >= '1998-01-01'
  AND date < '1999-01-01'
  AND k_symbol IN ('UROK', 'SANKC. UROK');

WITH top_amount AS (
    SELECT amount
    FROM loan
    ORDER BY amount DESC
    LIMIT 3
),
deposits AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposits
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
regions AS (
    SELECT A3 AS region, ROUND(AVG(A11), 2) AS avg_district_salary
    FROM district
    GROUP BY A3
),
loans_by_region AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS regional_loan_count
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
)
SELECT
    c.client_id,
    l.amount AS loan_amount,
    l.duration AS duration_months,
    ROUND(l.payments * l.duration, 2) AS total_payments,
    ROUND(l.payments * l.duration - l.amount, 2) AS interest_paid,
    l.status AS loan_status,
    branch.A2 AS branch_district,
    branch.A3 AS branch_region,
    COALESCE(dep.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(COALESCE(dep.total_deposits, 0), 2) AS total_deposits,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(dep.total_deposits, 0) > 2 * l.amount THEN 'High Income'
        WHEN COALESCE(dep.total_deposits, 0) > l.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
        ELSE 'Low Income'
    END AS income_category,
    lbr.regional_loan_count,
    reg.avg_district_salary,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
      - CASE WHEN strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) > '10-09' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN disp dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN district branch ON branch.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN deposits dep ON dep.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN regions reg ON reg.region = branch.A3
JOIN loans_by_region lbr ON lbr.region = branch.A3
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND l.amount >= (SELECT MIN(amount) FROM top_amount);

WITH qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS population,
        COUNT(l.loan_id) AS account_count
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN account AS a
        ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    JOIN loan AS l
        ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE l.duration > 24
      AND l.date < '1997-01-01'
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3, d.A4
),
region_totals AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        COUNT(*) AS district_count,
        SUM(population) AS combined_population,
        SUM(account_count) AS total_accounts
    FROM qualifying_districts
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT
    region,
    district_count,
    combined_population,
    total_accounts
FROM region_totals
ORDER BY combined_population DESC, region ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A11 AS salary,
        COUNT(*) AS account_count
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d
        ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
      AND a.date >= '1997-01-01'
      AND a.date < '1998-01-01'
      AND CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) >= 100000
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A11
)
SELECT
    SUM(account_count) AS total_accounts,
    COUNT(*) AS district_count,
    ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS average_salary
FROM qualifying_districts;

WITH eligible_accounts AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.date AS opened_date,
        c.gender,
        c.birth_date
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d
        ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    JOIN disp AS owner_disp
        ON owner_disp.account_id = a.account_id
       AND owner_disp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client AS c
        ON c.client_id = owner_disp.client_id
    WHERE d.A2 = 'Tabor'
      AND a.date <= '1996-12-31'
),
card_counts AS (
    SELECT
        disp.account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS card_count
    FROM card
    JOIN disp
        ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
    WHERE card.issued <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY disp.account_id
),
loan_stats AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
        MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_defaulted_loan,
        MAX(CASE WHEN status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_repaying_loan
    FROM loan
    WHERE date <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY account_id
),
transaction_stats AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out,
        MAX(balance) AS peak_balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE date >= '1997-01-01'
      AND date < '1998-01-01'
    GROUP BY account_id
),
profile AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.opened_date,
        a.gender,
        a.birth_date,
        COALESCE(cc.card_count, 0) AS card_count,
        COALESCE(ls.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(ls.loan_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'no loan'
            WHEN ls.has_defaulted_loan = 1 THEN 'defaulted'
            WHEN ls.has_repaying_loan = 1 THEN 'repaying'
            ELSE 'paid off'
        END AS loan_standing,
        COALESCE(ts.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
        COALESCE(ts.money_in, 0) AS money_in,
        COALESCE(ts.money_out, 0) AS money_out,
        COALESCE(ts.peak_balance, 0) AS peak_balance
    FROM eligible_accounts AS a
    LEFT JOIN card_counts AS cc
        ON cc.account_id = a.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_stats AS ls
        ON ls.account_id = a.account_id
    LEFT JOIN transaction_stats AS ts
        ON ts.account_id = a.account_id
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    opened_date,
    gender,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '1996-12-31') AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS INTEGER)
      - CASE
            WHEN strftime('%m-%d', birth_date) > '12-31' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS age_at_1996_12_31,
    card_count,
    loan_count,
    loan_standing,
    transaction_count,
    money_in,
    money_out,
    peak_balance,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance DESC) AS peak_balance_rank
FROM profile
ORDER BY peak_balance_rank, account_id;
