WITH eligible_accounts AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.district_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS classic_card_client_count
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN disp AS d
        ON d.account_id = a.account_id
       AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN card AS c
        ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
       AND c.type = 'classic'
    GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id
),
district_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ea.district_id,
        SUM(ea.classic_card_client_count) AS client_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ'
             AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
             AND t.account IS NOT NULL
            THEN t.bank || ':' || t.account
        END) AS external_account_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS outgoing_payment_total
    FROM eligible_accounts AS ea
    LEFT JOIN trans AS t
        ON t.account_id = ea.account_id
    GROUP BY ea.district_id
)
SELECT
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    COALESCE(dt.client_count, 0) AS client_count,
    COALESCE(dt.external_account_count, 0) AS external_account_count,
    COALESCE(dt.outgoing_payment_total, 0) AS outgoing_payment_total
FROM district AS d
LEFT JOIN district_totals AS dt
    ON dt.district_id = d.district_id
ORDER BY outgoing_payment_total DESC, district_name ASC;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS avg_salary
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date < '1930-01-01';

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS average_salary
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT district_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
      AND CAST(strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS INTEGER) < 1950
) AS client_districts
JOIN district AS d
    ON d.district_id = client_districts.district_id;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS average_district_salary
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.amount < 100000
  AND l.status = 'C';

SELECT ROUND(
    (CAST(race_853.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL) - CAST(race_854.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL))
    * 100.0 / CAST(race_854.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL),
    2
) AS percentage_higher
FROM results AS race_853
JOIN results AS race_854
    ON race_853.driverId = race_854.driverId
JOIN drivers AS d
    ON d.driverId = race_853.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Paul'
  AND d.surname = 'di Resta'
  AND race_853.raceId = 853
  AND race_854.raceId = 854;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN res.positionOrder <> 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage_not_victories
FROM results AS res
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND ra.year >= 2010;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality,
       COUNT(*) AS race_wins,
       (SELECT MAX(ds.points)
        FROM driverStandings ds
        WHERE ds.driverId = d.driverId) AS highest_standings_points
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE r.position = 1
GROUP BY d.driverId
ORDER BY race_wins DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * (MAX(milliseconds) - MIN(milliseconds)) / MAX(milliseconds),
    2
) AS percentage_shorter
FROM results
WHERE raceId = (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 1988
      AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
)
AND laps = (
    SELECT MAX(laps)
    FROM results
    WHERE raceId = (
        SELECT raceId
        FROM races
        WHERE year = 1988
          AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
    )
)
AND milliseconds IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
    r.year,
    printf('%.2f', AVG(res.milliseconds) / 1000.0) AS mean_elapsed_seconds
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res
    ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.year < 1975
  AND res.positionOrder = 1
  AND res.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.year
ORDER BY r.year;

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.dob < '1985-01-01' AND rs.laps > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM results AS rs
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = rs.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = rs.driverId
WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005;

SELECT c.name, c.nationality, SUM(cr.points) AS score
FROM constructorResults AS cr
JOIN constructors AS c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
JOIN races AS r ON cr.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix'
  AND r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.nationality
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2008
  AND c.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY q.q3
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    c.name AS circuit_name,
    printf(
        '%d:%02d.%03d',
        MIN(lt.milliseconds) / 60000,
        (MIN(lt.milliseconds) % 60000) / 1000,
        MIN(lt.milliseconds) % 1000
    ) AS fastest_lap_time
FROM circuits AS c
JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
JOIN lapTimes AS lt ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE c.country = 'Italy'
  AND lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.name;

WITH calendar_2000 AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 2000
),
races_2017_not_2000 AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 2017
      AND raceId NOT IN (SELECT raceId FROM calendar_2000)
),
per_race AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, COUNT(p.stop) AS pit_stop_count
    FROM races_2017_not_2000 AS r
    LEFT JOIN pitStops AS p ON p.raceId = r.raceId
    GROUP BY r.raceId
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(pit_stop_count), 2) AS average_pit_stops_per_race
FROM per_race;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, q.q1
FROM races r
JOIN qualifying q ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 1995
  AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
  AND q.q1 = (
      SELECT MIN(q2.q1)
      FROM qualifying q2
      WHERE q2.raceId = r.raceId
        AND q2.q1 IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 <> ''
  AND q.q2 = (
    SELECT MIN(q2)
    FROM qualifying
    WHERE raceId = q.raceId
      AND q2 <> ''
  );

SELECT d.forename, COUNT(*) AS runner_up_count
FROM races AS ra
JOIN results AS re ON re.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = re.driverId
WHERE ra.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND re.position = 2
GROUP BY d.forename
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY runner_up_count DESC, d.forename ASC;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.url,
       time(
           (julianday(r.date || ' ' || r.time) +
            CAST(res.milliseconds AS REAL) / 86400000.0)
       ) || '.' || printf('%03d', res.milliseconds % 1000) AS finish_local_time
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix'
  AND res.positionOrder = 1;

SELECT d.driverRef, d.nationality, d.dob
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 <> ''
  AND q.q3 = ''
ORDER BY d.driverRef;

WITH q2_times AS (
    SELECT
        q.q2,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY q.q2) AS time_rank
    FROM qualifying AS q
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
    WHERE r.year = 2017
      AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
      AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
      AND q.q2 <> ''
      AND q.q2 <> '\N'
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM q2_times AS t
JOIN qualifying AS q
  ON q.q2 = t.q2
JOIN races AS r
  ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d
  ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND t.time_rank = 2
ORDER BY d.nationality;

SELECT c.name AS racetrack,
       c.location,
       c.country,
       r.year AS season_year,
       p.duration AS pit_stop_length
FROM pitStops AS p
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = p.raceId
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
WHERE p.milliseconds = (SELECT MAX(milliseconds) FROM pitStops);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS qualifying_count
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(q.q1) <> ''
  AND d.code IS NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM drivers other
    WHERE other.forename = d.forename
      AND other.driverId <> d.driverId
  )
  AND (
    CAST(SUBSTR(q.q1, 1, INSTR(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
    + CAST(SUBSTR(q.q1, INSTR(q.q1, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER)
  ) >= 120;

SELECT d.driverRef AS reference_name,
       SUM(res.points) AS total_points
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN results AS res
  ON res.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Robert'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM lapTimes AS lt
      WHERE lt.driverId = res.driverId
        AND lt.raceId = res.raceId
  )
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.driverRef;

WITH editions AS (
    SELECT raceId, date
    FROM races
    WHERE name = 'French Grand Prix'
      AND year >= 1990
),
driver_best AS (
    SELECT l.raceId, l.driverId, MIN(l.milliseconds) AS best_ms
    FROM lapTimes AS l
    JOIN editions AS e ON e.raceId = l.raceId
    WHERE l.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY l.raceId, l.driverId
)
SELECT
    e.date,
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    CASE
        WHEN b.best_ms IS NOT NULL THEN
            CAST(b.best_ms / 60000 AS TEXT) || ':' ||
            printf('%02d.%03d',
                (b.best_ms / 1000) % 60,
                b.best_ms % 1000
            )
    END AS fastest_lap_time
FROM editions AS e
LEFT JOIN driver_best AS b
    ON b.raceId = e.raceId
   AND b.best_ms > 90000
LEFT JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = b.driverId
ORDER BY e.date, d.surname, d.forename;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, q.q3 AS fastest_q3_lap_time
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'Italian'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q3 <> ''
  AND q.q3 = (
      SELECT MIN(q2.q3)
      FROM qualifying AS q2
      JOIN drivers AS d2 ON d2.driverId = q2.driverId
      WHERE d2.nationality = 'Italian'
        AND q2.q3 IS NOT NULL
        AND q2.q3 <> ''
  );

WITH eligible_drivers AS (
    SELECT driverId, forename, surname
    FROM drivers
    WHERE nationality = 'British'
      AND CAST(substr(dob, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) > 1980
),
q3_times AS (
    SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
           r.name AS race_name,
           r.year AS race_year,
           q.q3 AS q3_time,
           CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60.0
               + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1) AS REAL) AS seconds
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN eligible_drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
    JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
    WHERE q.q3 IS NOT NULL
      AND trim(q.q3) <> ''
      AND q.q3 <> '\N'
)
SELECT driver_name, race_name, race_year, q3_time
FROM q3_times
WHERE seconds = (SELECT MIN(seconds) FROM q3_times);

WITH driver_race_fastest AS (
  SELECT raceId, driverId, MIN(milliseconds) AS fastest_ms
  FROM lapTimes
  WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY raceId, driverId
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    raceId,
    driverId,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceId ORDER BY fastest_ms) AS speed_rank
  FROM driver_race_fastest
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ranked.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM ranked
JOIN drivers ON drivers.driverId = ranked.driverId
WHERE ranked.speed_rank = 2
  AND drivers.dob >= '1976-01-01';

SELECT d.driverRef
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 <> ''
  AND q.q3 = (
    SELECT MIN(q2.q3)
    FROM qualifying AS q2
    WHERE q2.raceId = q.raceId
      AND q2.q3 <> ''
  );

WITH season_final AS (
    SELECT
        cs.constructorId,
        r.year,
        cs.points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cs.constructorId, r.year
            ORDER BY r.round DESC, cs.constructorStandingsId DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM constructorStandings AS cs
    JOIN races AS r
        ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.constructorId,
        c.name,
        c.url,
        COALESCE(SUM(sf.points), 0) AS career_points
    FROM constructors AS c
    LEFT JOIN season_final AS sf
        ON sf.constructorId = c.constructorId
       AND sf.rn = 1
    WHERE c.nationality = 'Italian'
    GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.url
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        name,
        career_points,
        url,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY career_points DESC) AS rnk
    FROM totals
)
SELECT
    name AS constructor_name,
    career_points,
    url AS introduction_website
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= 3
ORDER BY rnk, constructor_name;

SELECT d.forename, COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename IN ('Peter', 'John')
  AND r.position = 1
GROUP BY d.forename
ORDER BY d.forename;

SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(q.q3) <> ''
  AND (
    CAST(SUBSTR(q.q3, 1, INSTR(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
    + CAST(SUBSTR(q.q3, INSTR(q.q3, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
    + CAST(SUBSTR(q.q3, INSTR(q.q3, ':') + 4) AS INTEGER)
  ) = (
    SELECT MIN(
      CAST(SUBSTR(q2.q3, 1, INSTR(q2.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
      + CAST(SUBSTR(q2.q3, INSTR(q2.q3, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
      + CAST(SUBSTR(q2.q3, INSTR(q2.q3, ':') + 4) AS INTEGER)
    )
    FROM qualifying AS q2
    WHERE q2.q3 IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(q2.q3) <> ''
  );

SELECT
    c.nationality,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.rank = 1 THEN c.constructorId END) AS constructor_count
FROM constructors AS c
LEFT JOIN results AS r
    ON r.constructorId = c.constructorId
GROUP BY c.nationality
ORDER BY c.nationality;

SELECT
    r.year AS season_year,
    COUNT(p.stop) AS total_pit_stops
FROM races AS r
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ds.raceId
    FROM driverStandings AS ds
    JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = ds.driverId
    WHERE d.nationality = 'Australian'
      AND ds.position BETWEEN 1 AND 19
) AS qualifying_races ON qualifying_races.raceId = r.raceId
LEFT JOIN pitStops AS p ON p.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013
GROUP BY r.year
ORDER BY r.year;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
WHERE r.year = 1995
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(q.q1) <> ''
  AND (
    CAST(SUBSTR(TRIM(q.q1), 1, INSTR(TRIM(q.q1), ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
    + CAST(SUBSTR(TRIM(q.q1), INSTR(TRIM(q.q1), ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER)
  ) > 120;

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
       p.duration AS pit_stop_time,
       r.name AS race_name,
       c.name AS circuit_name,
       c.location AS circuit_location
FROM pitStops AS p
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = p.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = p.driverId
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
WHERE r.year = 2016
  AND strftime('%m', r.date) = '09'
  AND p.milliseconds = (
      SELECT MIN(p2.milliseconds)
      FROM pitStops AS p2
      JOIN races AS r2 ON r2.raceId = p2.raceId
      WHERE r2.year = 2016
        AND strftime('%m', r2.date) = '09'
  );

WITH winning_drivers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.dob, d.nationality
    FROM drivers AS d
    JOIN results AS res ON res.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE res.position = 1
),
oldest_winner AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM winning_drivers
    ORDER BY dob ASC, forename ASC, surname ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
first_win AS (
    SELECT r.name, r.date
    FROM results AS res
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    JOIN oldest_winner AS ow ON ow.driverId = res.driverId
    WHERE res.position = 1
    ORDER BY r.date ASC, r.name ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
career_starts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceId) AS starts
    FROM results AS res
    JOIN oldest_winner AS ow ON ow.driverId = res.driverId
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE r.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017
)
SELECT
    ow.forename || ' ' || ow.surname AS full_name,
    ow.nationality,
    fw.name AS first_race_won,
    fw.date AS first_win_date,
    cs.starts AS total_races_started
FROM oldest_winner AS ow
CROSS JOIN first_win AS fw
CROSS JOIN career_starts AS cs;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId)
FROM races AS r
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN status AS s ON s.statusId = res.statusId
WHERE c.country = 'Canada'
  AND r.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND LOWER(s.status) = 'accident';

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorId = q.constructorId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 <> ''
ORDER BY q.q2 ASC, q.position ASC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1;

SELECT d.surname, r.name AS race_name
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 <> ''
  AND q.q2 = (
      SELECT MIN(q2)
      FROM qualifying
      JOIN races ON races.raceId = qualifying.raceId
      WHERE races.year = 2017
        AND qualifying.q2 IS NOT NULL
        AND qualifying.q2 <> ''
  );

SELECT d.number
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 <> ''
  AND q.q3 = (
    SELECT MIN(q2.q3)
    FROM qualifying AS q2
    WHERE q2.raceId = q.raceId
      AND q2.q3 <> ''
  );

SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 = (
    SELECT MIN(q2.q3)
    FROM qualifying AS q2
    JOIN races AS r2 ON r2.raceId = q2.raceId
    WHERE r2.year = 2017
      AND r2.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
      AND q2.q3 <> ''
  );

SELECT r.year AS season_year,
       runner_up.time AS runner_up_gap
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS runner_up
  ON runner_up.raceId = r.raceId
 AND runner_up.positionOrder = 2
WHERE r.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
  AND r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
  AND r.time = (
      SELECT MIN(time)
      FROM races
      WHERE name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
        AND year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
        AND time IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY r.year DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.code
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q3 <> ''
ORDER BY d.code;

SELECT
    r.year,
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    res.time AS finish_time
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
WHERE r.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND r.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017
  AND r.time <= '17:00:00'
  AND res.position = 1
ORDER BY r.year;

WITH timed_races AS (
    SELECT
        c.circuitRef,
        r.time,
        CAST(substr(r.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600
            + CAST(substr(r.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60
            + CAST(substr(r.time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) AS seconds_after_midnight
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL
),
extremes AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(seconds_after_midnight) AS earliest_seconds,
        MAX(seconds_after_midnight) AS latest_seconds
    FROM timed_races
)
SELECT
    t.circuitRef,
    t.time AS start_time,
    CASE
        WHEN t.seconds_after_midnight = e.earliest_seconds THEN 'earliest'
        WHEN t.seconds_after_midnight = e.latest_seconds THEN 'latest'
    END AS which_extreme,
    e.latest_seconds - e.earliest_seconds AS gap_seconds
FROM timed_races AS t
CROSS JOIN extremes AS e
WHERE t.seconds_after_midnight IN (e.earliest_seconds, e.latest_seconds)
GROUP BY t.circuitRef, t.time, which_extreme, gap_seconds
ORDER BY which_extreme, t.circuitRef;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN results AS r ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.dob >= '1980-01-01'
  AND d.dob < '1991-01-01'
  AND r.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(r.fastestLapSpeed) <> ''
GROUP BY d.driverId
ORDER BY MAX(CAST(r.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) DESC,
         d.dob ASC,
         d.surname COLLATE NOCASE ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT d.driverRef
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q1 <> ''
  AND (q.q2 IS NULL OR q.q2 = '')
ORDER BY q.q1 DESC, q.driverId ASC;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE
        WHEN s.status = 'Finished' OR s.status LIKE '+% Lap%' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN status AS s ON s.statusId = res.statusId
WHERE r.year = 1957
  AND r.name = 'British Grand Prix';

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_total), 2) AS mean_total_expense_per_event
FROM (
    SELECT b.link_to_event, SUM(x.cost) AS event_total
    FROM expense AS x
    JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = x.link_to_member
    JOIN budget AS b ON b.budget_id = x.link_to_budget
    WHERE m.first_name = 'Elijah'
      AND m.last_name = 'Allen'
      AND strftime('%m', x.expense_date) IN ('09', '10')
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event
);

SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(e.event_date, 1, 4) = '2019' THEN b.spent ELSE 0 END), 0)
    - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(e.event_date, 1, 4) = '2020' THEN b.spent ELSE 0 END), 0) AS amount_difference
FROM event AS e
JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE substr(e.event_date, 1, 4) IN ('2019', '2020');

SELECT notes
FROM income
WHERE date_received = '2019-09-14'
  AND source = 'Fundraising';

SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS name
FROM member AS m
JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
GROUP BY m.member_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_event) > 7;

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member AS m
JOIN expense AS e ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense);

WITH event_counts AS (
  SELECT e.event_id, e.event_name, COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS attendance_count
  FROM event AS e
  LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
  WHERE e.event_date >= '2019-09-01'
    AND e.event_date < '2019-12-01'
  GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN event_name = 'Women''s Soccer' THEN attendance_count END) AS soccer_count,
    ROUND(AVG(attendance_count), 1) AS average_count
  FROM event_counts
)
SELECT
  soccer_count,
  average_count,
  CASE
    WHEN soccer_count > average_count THEN 'more'
    WHEN soccer_count < average_count THEN 'fewer'
    ELSE 'equal'
  END AS verdict
FROM stats;

SELECT
    maj.department,
    COALESCE(SUM(i.amount), 0) AS total_dues
FROM major AS maj
LEFT JOIN member AS m
    ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id
   AND m.position = 'Member'
   AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
       FROM attendance AS a
       WHERE a.link_to_member = m.member_id
   )
LEFT JOIN income AS i
    ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
   AND i.source = 'Dues'
WHERE maj.college = 'College of Engineering'
GROUP BY maj.department;

WITH qualifying_lines AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member, link_to_budget
    FROM expense
    WHERE cost > 50
),
line_totals AS (
    SELECT
        q.link_to_member,
        q.link_to_budget,
        b.amount - COALESCE(SUM(all_expenses.cost), 0) AS remaining
    FROM qualifying_lines q
    JOIN budget b ON b.budget_id = q.link_to_budget
    LEFT JOIN expense all_expenses ON all_expenses.link_to_budget = q.link_to_budget
    GROUP BY q.link_to_member, q.link_to_budget, b.amount
)
SELECT
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    ROUND(SUM(l.remaining), 2) AS total_remaining
FROM line_totals l
JOIN member m ON m.member_id = l.link_to_member
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
ORDER BY total_remaining DESC, m.last_name ASC, m.first_name ASC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS unrepresented_majors
FROM major AS target_major
WHERE target_major.college = (
    SELECT tyler_major.college
    FROM "member" AS tyler
    JOIN major AS tyler_major
      ON tyler.link_to_major = tyler_major.major_id
    WHERE tyler.first_name = 'Tyler'
      AND tyler.last_name = 'Hewitt'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "member" AS enrolled
    WHERE enrolled.link_to_major = target_major.major_id
);

WITH advertising_events AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event
    FROM budget
    WHERE LOWER(category) = 'advertising'
      AND link_to_event IS NOT NULL
),
attendance_counts AS (
    SELECT ev.link_to_event, COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS member_count
    FROM advertising_events ev
    LEFT JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = ev.link_to_event
    GROUP BY ev.link_to_event
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(member_count), 2) AS average_members_per_event
FROM attendance_counts;

SELECT e.event_name, e.location, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS attendee_count
FROM event AS e
LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
    ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.type = 'Budget'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name, e.location
ORDER BY e.event_date;

WITH major_counts AS (
    SELECT m.major_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS attendee_count
    FROM event e
    JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
    JOIN member mb ON mb.member_id = a.link_to_member
    JOIN major m ON m.major_id = mb.link_to_major
    WHERE e.event_name = 'Football game'
    GROUP BY m.major_id, m.major_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT major_name,
           attendee_count,
           MAX(attendee_count) OVER () AS max_count
    FROM major_counts
)
SELECT major_name, attendee_count
FROM ranked
WHERE attendee_count = max_count
ORDER BY major_name;

WITH member_attendance AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer')
                THEN 'officer'
            ELSE 'other'
        END AS member_group,
        COUNT(DISTINCT attendance.link_to_event) AS events_attended
    FROM member
    LEFT JOIN attendance
        ON attendance.link_to_member = member.member_id
    GROUP BY member.member_id
)
SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN member_group = 'officer' THEN events_attended END), 2) AS average_events_per_officer,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN member_group = 'other' THEN events_attended END), 2) AS average_events_per_other_student
FROM member_attendance;

WITH RECURSIVE over_events AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event
    FROM budget
    WHERE remaining < 0
),
item_names(item, rest) AS (
    SELECT
        lower(trim(substr(x.expense_description || ',', 1, instr(x.expense_description || ',', ',') - 1))),
        substr(x.expense_description || ',', instr(x.expense_description || ',', ',') + 1)
    FROM expense AS x
    JOIN budget AS b ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    JOIN over_events AS oe ON oe.link_to_event = b.link_to_event

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        lower(trim(substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ',') - 1))),
        substr(rest, instr(rest, ',') + 1)
    FROM item_names
    WHERE rest <> ''
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT item)
FROM item_names
WHERE item <> '';

SELECT
    e.event_name,
    ROUND(COALESCE(w.water_total, 0) / a.attendee_count, 2) AS amount_per_attendee
FROM event AS e
JOIN (
    SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(*) AS attendee_count
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_event
) AS a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT b.link_to_event, SUM(ex.cost) AS water_total
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN expense AS ex ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    WHERE LOWER(ex.expense_description) LIKE '%water%'
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event
) AS w ON w.link_to_event = e.event_id;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS humanities_social_sciences_members,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.college IS NULL OR m.college <> 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS other_members
FROM member AS r
LEFT JOIN major AS m
    ON r.link_to_major = m.major_id;

SELECT expense_date, SUM(cost) AS total_cost
FROM expense
WHERE link_to_member IN (
    SELECT member_id
    FROM member
    WHERE position = 'Vice President'
)
GROUP BY expense_date
ORDER BY expense_date DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT e.type AS event_category,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS member_count
FROM event AS e
LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
    ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.location = 'MU 215'
GROUP BY e.type
ORDER BY e.type;

WITH college_counts AS (
  SELECT ma.college, COUNT(*) AS major_count
  FROM "member" AS me
  JOIN major AS ma ON me.link_to_major = ma.major_id
  GROUP BY ma.college
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT college, major_count, MAX(major_count) OVER () AS max_count
  FROM college_counts
)
SELECT college, major_count
FROM ranked
WHERE major_count = max_count
ORDER BY college;

SELECT ev.location,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ex.expense_description) AS different_things_bought
FROM event AS ev
JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
JOIN expense AS ex ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
WHERE b.amount > 40
GROUP BY ev.location;

SELECT SUM(b.amount) AS total_budgeted
FROM budget AS b
JOIN event AS ev ON ev.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE ev.event_date >= '2019-09-01'
  AND ev.event_date < '2019-10-01'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM expense AS ex
    JOIN budget AS eb ON eb.budget_id = ex.link_to_budget
    WHERE eb.link_to_event = ev.event_id
      AND ex.expense_description = 'Pizza'
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_total), 2) AS average_spent_per_event
FROM (
    SELECT e.event_id, COALESCE(SUM(b.spent), 0) AS event_total
    FROM event AS e
    LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id
);

WITH event_totals AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.event_name,
        SUM(COALESCE(b.amount, 0)) AS total_budget,
        SUM(COALESCE(b.spent, 0)) AS total_spending
    FROM event AS e
    LEFT JOIN budget AS b
        ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE e.status = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
),
purchase_counts AS (
    SELECT
        b.link_to_event AS event_id,
        SUM(
            LENGTH(TRIM(x.expense_description))
            - LENGTH(REPLACE(TRIM(x.expense_description), ',', ''))
            + 1
        ) AS purchase_count
    FROM expense AS x
    JOIN budget AS b
        ON b.budget_id = x.link_to_budget
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event
)
SELECT et.event_name
FROM event_totals AS et
LEFT JOIN purchase_counts AS pc
    ON pc.event_id = et.event_id
WHERE et.total_spending <= et.total_budget
ORDER BY COALESCE(pc.purchase_count, 0) DESC, et.event_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT e.type AS event_type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS member_count
FROM event AS e
JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE date(e.event_date) BETWEEN date('2019-09-01') AND date('2020-05-31')
GROUP BY e.type
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) >= ALL (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a2.link_to_member)
    FROM event AS e2
    JOIN attendance AS a2 ON a2.link_to_event = e2.event_id
    WHERE date(e2.event_date) BETWEEN date('2019-09-01') AND date('2020-05-31')
    GROUP BY e2.type
);

WITH approved_purchases AS (
    SELECT
        b.category,
        e.cost,
        e.expense_description
    FROM expense AS e
    JOIN budget AS b
        ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    JOIN event AS ev
        ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
    WHERE ev.event_name = 'October Meeting'
      AND e.approved = 'true'
),
purchase_items AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        cost,
        TRIM(item) AS item
    FROM approved_purchases,
         json_each(
             '["' || REPLACE(expense_description, ', ', '","') || '"]'
         )
)
SELECT
    item,
    category,
    SUM(cost) AS total_cost
FROM purchase_items
GROUP BY category, item
ORDER BY category, item;

SELECT
    e.event_name,
    e.event_date,
    COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT b.amount), 0) AS total_budgeted,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS members_attended
FROM event AS e
LEFT JOIN budget AS b
    ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
    ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name, e.event_date
ORDER BY e.event_name ASC, e.event_date ASC;

SELECT e.expense_description AS item_name, COUNT(*) AS times_bought
FROM expense AS e
JOIN member AS m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.first_name = 'Sacha'
  AND m.last_name = 'Harrison'
GROUP BY e.expense_description
ORDER BY e.expense_description;

WITH oct_nov AS (
  SELECT link_to_member, expense_description, cost
  FROM expense
  WHERE expense_date >= '2019-10-01'
    AND expense_date < '2019-12-01'
),
items AS (
  SELECT link_to_member, TRIM(value) AS item
  FROM oct_nov,
       json_each(
         '["' || REPLACE(REPLACE(expense_description, '"', '\"'), ', ', '","') || '"]'
       )
),
kind_counts AS (
  SELECT link_to_member, COUNT(DISTINCT item) AS kind_count
  FROM items
  GROUP BY link_to_member
),
spending AS (
  SELECT link_to_member, SUM(cost) AS total_spending
  FROM oct_nov
  GROUP BY link_to_member
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT link_to_member,
         kind_count,
         total_spending,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY kind_count DESC) AS rnk
  FROM kind_counts
  JOIN spending USING (link_to_member)
)
SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name,
       r.kind_count,
       r.total_spending
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = r.link_to_member
WHERE r.rnk = 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT major.major_name) AS different_majors
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.department = 'Political Science';

SELECT c.colour,
       COUNT(*) AS hero_count,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND a.alignment = 'Good'
  AND s.eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.colour
ORDER BY hero_count DESC, c.colour ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT h.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS h
JOIN publisher AS p ON h.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON h.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND sp.power_name = 'Super Strength'
ORDER BY h.superhero_name;

SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Neutral' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS neutral_percentage,
  SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Neutral' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neutral_marvel_count
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;

SELECT p.publisher_name AS publisher,
       COUNT(*) AS superhero_count,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero s2 JOIN publisher p2 ON p2.id = s2.publisher_id WHERE p2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')
       - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero s3 JOIN publisher p3 ON p3.id = s3.publisher_id WHERE p3.publisher_name = 'DC Comics') AS difference
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics')
GROUP BY p.publisher_name
ORDER BY superhero_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT superhero_name
FROM superhero
WHERE height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND (eye_colour_id IS NULL OR eye_colour_id = 1);

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage_marvel
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180;

SELECT s.superhero_name, p.publisher_name
FROM superhero AS s
LEFT JOIN publisher AS p
    ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE s.eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL
  AND s.hair_colour_id IS NOT NULL
  AND s.skin_colour_id IS NOT NULL
  AND s.eye_colour_id = s.hair_colour_id
  AND s.hair_colour_id = s.skin_colour_id;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
LEFT JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female';

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female';

SELECT CASE
         WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) =
              SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           THEN 'Tie'
         WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >
              SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           THEN 'DC Comics by ' || (
             SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
             SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           )
         ELSE 'Marvel Comics by ' || (
             SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
             SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           )
       END AS result
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics');

SELECT COUNT(*) AS power_count
FROM superpower p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_power strength_hp
    JOIN superpower strength ON strength.id = strength_hp.power_id
    WHERE strength.power_name = 'Super Strength'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM hero_power matching_hp
          WHERE matching_hp.hero_id = strength_hp.hero_id
            AND matching_hp.power_id = p.id
      )
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_power other_hp
    WHERE other_hp.power_id = p.id
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM hero_power strength_hp2
          JOIN superpower strength2 ON strength2.id = strength_hp2.power_id
          WHERE strength2.power_name = 'Super Strength'
            AND strength_hp2.hero_id = other_hp.hero_id
      )
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 1) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id
WHERE LOWER(c.colour) = 'green'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT p.power_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS hero_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS pub ON pub.id = s.publisher_id
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower AS p ON p.id = hp.power_id
WHERE pub.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
GROUP BY p.id, p.power_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) = (
  SELECT MAX(power_count)
  FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s2.id) AS power_count
    FROM superhero AS s2
    JOIN publisher AS pub2 ON pub2.id = s2.publisher_id
    JOIN hero_power AS hp2 ON hp2.hero_id = s2.id
    JOIN superpower AS p2 ON p2.id = hp2.power_id
    WHERE pub2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
      AND s2.full_name IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(s2.full_name) <> ''
    GROUP BY p2.id
  )
)
ORDER BY p.power_name;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT ha2.attribute_value
      FROM superhero AS ab
      JOIN hero_attribute AS ha2 ON ha2.hero_id = ab.id
      JOIN attribute AS a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
      WHERE ab.superhero_name = 'Abomination'
        AND a2.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT hha.attribute_value
      FROM superhero AS h
      JOIN hero_attribute AS hha ON hha.hero_id = h.id
      JOIN attribute AS hattr ON hattr.id = hha.attribute_id
      WHERE h.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
        AND hattr.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  )
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id)
FROM superhero AS h
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = h.id
WHERE h.height_cm >= (
    SELECT height_cm
    FROM superhero
    WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY height_cm DESC
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9
);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_no_race
FROM superhero s
WHERE s.publisher_id = (
    SELECT publisher_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb'
)
AND s.race_id IS NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 1) AS average_superpowers
FROM (
    SELECT hp.hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
    FROM hero_power hp
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM hero_power cryo_hp
        JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = cryo_hp.power_id
        WHERE LOWER(sp.power_name) = 'cryokinesis'
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM hero_power shared_hp
              WHERE shared_hp.hero_id = hp.hero_id
                AND shared_hp.power_id = cryo_hp.power_id
          )
    )
    GROUP BY hp.hero_id
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS d ON d.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE d.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM superhero AS m
      JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = m.publisher_id
      WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
        AND m.eye_colour_id = s.eye_colour_id
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(height_cm AS REAL)), 1)
FROM superhero
WHERE race_id = (
    SELECT race_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb'
)
AND height_cm IS NOT NULL;

SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg)
FROM superhero AS s
WHERE s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.race_id IN (
      SELECT r.id
      FROM race AS r
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM superhero AS f
          JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = f.gender_id
          WHERE f.race_id = r.id
            AND LOWER(g.gender) = 'female'
      )
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT publisher_id) AS publisher_count
FROM superhero
WHERE height_cm > 200
  AND publisher_id IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS superhero_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Good'
  AND s.publisher_id NOT IN (
      SELECT id
      FROM publisher
      WHERE publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 1) AS average_weight_kg,
       COUNT(s.weight_kg) AS superhero_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero AS h
WHERE h.publisher_id = (
    SELECT publisher_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE superhero_name = 'Blackwulf'
)
AND h.eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM superhero AS other
    WHERE other.eye_colour_id = h.eye_colour_id
      AND other.publisher_id IS NOT NULL
      AND other.publisher_id <> h.publisher_id
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(ha.attribute_value), 1) AS average_intelligence
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE LOWER(a.attribute_name) = 'intelligence'
  AND ha.attribute_value IS NOT NULL
  AND ha.hero_id IN (
    SELECT hp.hero_id
    FROM hero_power hp
    JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
    WHERE LOWER(sp.power_name) IN ('super speed', 'death touch')
  );

SELECT g.gender,
       ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(p.power_count, 0)), 2) AS average_superpowers_per_hero
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT power_id) AS power_count
    FROM hero_power
    GROUP BY hero_id
) AS p ON p.hero_id = s.id
WHERE LOWER(g.gender) IN ('male', 'female')
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
  AND INSTR(TRIM(s.full_name), ' ') > 0
GROUP BY g.gender;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.height_cm), 2) AS avg_height_cm,
       ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN colour AS c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad'
  AND c.colour = 'Green';

SELECT
  (SELECT ROUND(AVG(height_cm), 1)
   FROM superhero s
   JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
   WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas'
     AND s.height_cm IS NOT NULL) AS avg_height_cm,
  (SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight_kg), 1)
   FROM superhero s
   JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
   WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas'
     AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL) AS avg_weight_kg;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(h.height_cm AS REAL)), 1) AS average_height_cm
FROM superhero h
WHERE h.height_cm IS NOT NULL
  AND h.superhero_name <> '3-D Man'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM hero_power hp
      JOIN hero_power hp3 ON hp.power_id = hp3.power_id
      JOIN superhero man ON man.id = hp3.hero_id
      WHERE hp.hero_id = h.id
        AND man.superhero_name = '3-D Man'
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(s.weight_kg AS REAL)), 2)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM hero_power AS hp
      WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(s.weight_kg AS REAL)), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
  AND a.alignment = 'Good'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

WITH lightest AS (
    SELECT MIN(weight_kg) AS min_weight
    FROM superhero
    WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(power_count), 0)
FROM (
    SELECT s.id, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
    FROM superhero AS s
    JOIN lightest AS l ON s.weight_kg = l.min_weight
    LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
    GROUP BY s.id
);

SELECT s.superhero_name, s.full_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE lower(a.attribute_name) = 'speed'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)
      FROM hero_attribute AS ha2
      JOIN attribute AS a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
      WHERE lower(a2.attribute_name) = 'speed'
  )
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND trim(s.full_name) <> ''
  AND trim(s.full_name) <> '-'
ORDER BY s.superhero_name;

SELECT eye.colour AS eye_colour, COUNT(*) AS hero_count
FROM superhero AS h
JOIN colour AS hair ON hair.id = h.hair_colour_id
JOIN colour AS eye ON eye.id = h.eye_colour_id
WHERE h.eye_colour_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT brown_hair_hero.eye_colour_id
    FROM superhero AS brown_hair_hero
    JOIN colour AS brown_hair ON brown_hair.id = brown_hair_hero.hair_colour_id
    WHERE brown_hair.colour = 'Brown'
)
AND hair.colour <> 'Brown'
GROUP BY h.eye_colour_id, eye.colour
ORDER BY hero_count DESC, eye_colour ASC;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
LEFT JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> '';

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM hero_power AS hp
      WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2)
FROM superhero AS s
WHERE s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.id <> (SELECT id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = '3-D Man')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_power AS hp
    JOIN hero_power AS h3 ON h3.power_id = hp.power_id
    WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id
      AND h3.hero_id = (SELECT id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = '3-D Man')
  );

SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM superhero s
     JOIN colour c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
     WHERE s.weight_kg IS NULL AND c.colour = 'No Colour')
  - (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM superhero s
     JOIN colour c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
     WHERE s.weight_kg IS NULL AND c.colour = 'Blue') AS difference;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(L.ALB), 4) AS avg_alb
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.PLT > 400
  AND P.SEX = 'F'
  AND P.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.TG >= 200
  AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
  AND date(p.Birthday, '+50 years') < date('2026-10-09');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(p.SEX)) = 'female'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND LOWER(TRIM(l.SC170)) IN ('negative', '0')
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination AS e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
      AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE Birthday >= '1930-01-01'
  AND Birthday < '1941-01-01'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory WHERE Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID);

WITH strongest AS (
    SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS REAL)) AS max_rnp
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(RNP AS REAL) IS NOT NULL
),
r AS (
    SELECT l.ID, l.Date, l."T-BIL"
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    CROSS JOIN strongest AS s
    WHERE CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) = s.max_rnp
)
SELECT
    r."T-BIL" AS total_bilirubin,
    r.Date AS lab_test_date,
    p.ID AS patient_id,
    p.SEX AS sex,
    p.Birthday AS birthday
FROM r
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = r.ID
WHERE r."T-BIL" = (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") FROM r)
ORDER BY r.Date, p.ID;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
WHERE p.Birthday > '1960-01-01'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
      AND e.Thrombosis = 1
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.RNP IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(LOWER(l.RNP)) <> 'negative'
      AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 10
  );

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.Admission = '-'
      AND l.SSA IS NOT NULL
      AND l.SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0')
),
patient_titers AS (
    SELECT l.ID, MAX(CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER)) AS anti_rnp_titer
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN eligible AS e ON e.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l.RNP IS NOT NULL
      AND l.RNP NOT IN ('negative', '0')
    GROUP BY l.ID
)
SELECT ID, anti_rnp_titer
FROM patient_titers
WHERE anti_rnp_titer = (SELECT MAX(anti_rnp_titer) FROM patient_titers);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'MCTD'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 5
  );

WITH lab_counts AS (
  SELECT ID, COUNT(DISTINCT Date) AS lab_dates
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT p.SEX, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(l.lab_dates, 0)), 2) AS average_lab_test_dates
FROM Patient p
LEFT JOIN lab_counts l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
  )
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY p.SEX;

SELECT Admission, COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient
WHERE Admission IN ('+', '-')
  AND ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CAST(RNP AS REAL) > 16
  )
GROUP BY Admission
ORDER BY Admission DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.HCT IS NOT NULL
      AND (l.HCT <= 29 OR l.HCT >= 52)
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.RNP IS NOT NULL
      AND l.RNP <> 'negative'
      AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 16
);

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.PLT > 100
      AND l.PLT < 400
  ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_with_normal_platelet,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.PLT > 100
      AND l.PLT < 400
  ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_never_with_normal_platelet
FROM Patient p
WHERE REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(p.Diagnosis), ' ', ''), ',', '') IN ('RASJS', 'SJSRA');

SELECT ROUND(AVG(l.TP - 8.5), 3) AS avg_deviation
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.TP > 8.5
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = l.ID
        AND e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
  );

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.ID IN (
    SELECT l.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')
);

SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 32
  )
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY p.SEX;

SELECT MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS youngest_age
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 64
  AND l.RNP GLOB '[0-9]*'
  AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
  AND l.Date IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
    COUNT(l.ID) AS total_laboratory_tests,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) - COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS patients_with_no_laboratory_tests
FROM Patient AS p
LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l
    ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE LOWER(p.Diagnosis) LIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID)
FROM Examination
WHERE date("Examination Date") BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND Thrombosis > 0;

SELECT e.Symptoms
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
  AND e.Thrombosis = 1
GROUP BY e.Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, e.Symptoms ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(ROUND(AVG(julianday(first_exam) - julianday("First Date"))) AS INTEGER) AS average_delay_days
FROM (
    SELECT p.ID,
           p."First Date",
           MIN(e."Examination Date") AS first_exam
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.Admission LIKE '%+%'
      AND e.Thrombosis = 1
      AND p."First Date" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.ID
);

SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.Date >= '1994-01-01'
  AND l.Date < '1995-01-01'
  AND l.GOT < 60
  AND p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY p.SEX;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN p.ID END)
     - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN p.ID END) AS difference
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.UN < 30
  );

SELECT
    p.SEX,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.CRE >= 1.5 THEN p.ID END) AS patients_with_creatinine_out_of_range,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS total_patients,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.CRE >= 1.5 THEN p.ID END)
        / COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID),
        1
    ) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS p
LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l
    ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX IN ('M', 'F')
GROUP BY p.SEX;

WITH maxima AS (
  SELECT p.Admission, MAX(l.`T-CHO`) AS max_tcho
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
  GROUP BY p.Admission
)
SELECT m.Admission, m.max_tcho AS `T-CHO`, p.ID
FROM maxima AS m
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.Admission = m.Admission
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID AND l.`T-CHO` = m.max_tcho
ORDER BY CASE m.Admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END, p.ID;

WITH first_visit_1991 AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE strftime('%Y', `First Date`) = '1991'
),
recorded AS (
    SELECT l.ID, CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER) AS anti_rnp_level
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN first_visit_1991 AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l.RNP IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(l.RNP) <> ''
)
SELECT ID, anti_rnp_level
FROM recorded
WHERE anti_rnp_level = (SELECT MAX(anti_rnp_level) FROM recorded)
ORDER BY ID;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN 'Hospital'
        WHEN p.Admission = '-' THEN 'Outpatient clinic'
    END AS care_setting,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND CASE
                WHEN l."U-PRO" = '>=1000' THEN 1000
                WHEN l."U-PRO" LIKE '>=%' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(l."U-PRO", 3) AS REAL)
                WHEN l."U-PRO" LIKE '+%(%' THEN CAST(
                    SUBSTR(
                        l."U-PRO",
                        INSTR(l."U-PRO", '(') + 1,
                        INSTR(l."U-PRO", ')') - INSTR(l."U-PRO", '(') - 1
                    ) AS REAL
                )
                WHEN l."U-PRO" GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(l."U-PRO" AS REAL)
                ELSE NULL
            END >= 30
  )
GROUP BY p.Admission
ORDER BY p.Admission DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination AS e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
      AND (e.KCT = '+' OR e.RVVT = '+' OR e.LAC = '+')
  );

WITH latest_sample AS (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS latest_date
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
latest_scl70 AS (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS latest_date
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE SC170 IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT ls.ID
FROM latest_sample AS ls
JOIN Laboratory AS sample
    ON sample.ID = ls.ID
   AND sample.Date = ls.latest_date
JOIN latest_scl70 AS l70
    ON l70.ID = ls.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS result
    ON result.ID = l70.ID
   AND result.Date = l70.latest_date
WHERE ls.latest_date > '1997-01-01'
  AND LOWER(TRIM(result.SC170)) IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l1.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS l1
WHERE l1.SSA IS NOT NULL
  AND LOWER(TRIM(l1.SSA)) NOT IN ('negative', '0')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l2
      WHERE l2.ID = l1.ID
        AND l2."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL
        AND LOWER(TRIM(l2."U-PRO")) NOT IN ('negative', 'none')
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND (CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) < 8 OR l."DNA-II" < 8);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission <> '-'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.ALP >= 300
  );

SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS REAL))
FROM Laboratory
WHERE CRE < 1.5
  AND RNP GLOB '[0-9]*';

SELECT CASE SEX
           WHEN 'F' THEN 'female'
           WHEN 'M' THEN 'male'
       END AS sex,
       COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.HGB < 7.0
  AND SEX IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY SEX;

SELECT ID, Date, RNP
FROM Laboratory
WHERE GOT >= 60
  AND CAST(RNP AS REAL) = (
    SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS REAL))
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE GOT >= 60
      AND RNP IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(RNP) <> ''
      AND LOWER(RNP) <> 'negative'
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS eligible_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND (
        l.FG < 150
        OR l.FG > 450
        OR TRIM(l."U-PRO") IN ('3', '4')
        OR (
          TRIM(l."U-PRO") GLOB '[0-9]*'
          AND CAST(TRIM(l."U-PRO") AS REAL) >= 300
        )
        OR (
          TRIM(l."U-PRO") GLOB '>=*'
          AND CAST(SUBSTR(TRIM(l."U-PRO"), 3) AS REAL) >= 300
        )
      )
  );

SELECT
    CASE p.Admission
        WHEN '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital'
        WHEN '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
    END AS patient_group,
    COUNT(*) AS normal_ldh_measurements
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
  AND (
      p.Diagnosis LIKE '%APS%'
      OR p.Diagnosis LIKE '%MCTD%'
      OR p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
  )
  AND l.LDH < 500
GROUP BY p.Admission
ORDER BY CASE p.Admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patients_with_lab_result,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 THEN p.ID END) AS patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND p.Birthday >= '1945-01-01'
  AND p.Birthday < '1990-01-01'
  AND p.Admission LIKE '+%'
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` = 'P';

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, MAX(CAST(L.RNP AS REAL)) AS highest_rnp
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS H
      WHERE H.ID = P.ID AND H.HGB < 10
  )
  AND L.RNP GLOB '[0-9]*'
GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX
HAVING MAX(CAST(L.RNP AS REAL)) = (
    SELECT MAX(CAST(L2.RNP AS REAL))
    FROM Patient AS P2
    JOIN Laboratory AS L2 ON L2.ID = P2.ID
    WHERE P2.Admission = '-'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM Laboratory AS H2
          WHERE H2.ID = P2.ID AND H2.HGB < 10
      )
      AND L2.RNP GLOB '[0-9]*'
);

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        Date,
        GOT,
        RNP,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
  AND GOT < 60
  AND CAST(RNP AS REAL) > 10;

WITH RankedProteinuria AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        Date,
        `U-PRO`,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE `U-PRO` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    P.ID,
    P.SEX,
    R.Date AS MostRecentProteinuriaTestDate,
    R.`U-PRO` AS ProteinuriaLevel
FROM RankedProteinuria AS R
JOIN Patient AS P ON P.ID = R.ID
WHERE R.rn = 1
ORDER BY P.ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 0
  AND e.Thrombosis = 0;

WITH elevated AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CAST(RNP AS REAL) >= 16
),
normal_only AS (
    SELECT ID, MAX(GPT) AS max_gpt
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN GPT IS NULL OR GPT >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
)
SELECT p.Birthday
FROM elevated e
JOIN normal_only n ON n.ID = e.ID
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID
ORDER BY n.max_gpt DESC, p.ID ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e
  ON e.ID = p.ID
 AND e.Thrombosis = 1
JOIN Laboratory AS l
  ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.PT < 14
  AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 16;

SELECT
    CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
      - (strftime('%m-%d', l.Date) < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) AS age,
    p.Diagnosis
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '+'
  AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) DESC, l.Date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE (
    p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
    OR p.Diagnosis LIKE 'SLE,%'
    OR p.Diagnosis LIKE 'SLE %'
    OR p.Diagnosis LIKE '% SLE'
    OR p.Diagnosis LIKE '% SLE,%'
    OR p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE' || char(29) || '%'
    OR p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE,%'
)
AND p.Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%SLE susp%'
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.`T-BIL` >= 1.2
)
ORDER BY p.SEX, p.ID;

WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        CASE
            WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 'Admitted to the hospital'
            ELSE 'Followed at the outpatient clinic'
        END AS care_setting
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'F'
      AND date(Birthday, '+50 years') <= '2026-10-09'
      AND Admission IN ('+', '-')
),
patient_results AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID,
        c.care_setting,
        MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_elevated
    FROM cohort AS c
    LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = c.ID
    GROUP BY c.ID, c.care_setting
)
SELECT
    care_setting,
    SUM(has_elevated) AS patients_with_at_least_one_result_ge_4,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_elevated = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_with_no_such_result
FROM patient_results
GROUP BY care_setting
ORDER BY care_setting;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(l2.Date)
        FROM Laboratory AS l2
        WHERE l2.ID = p.ID
      )
      AND l.IGG >= 2000
  );

SELECT p.ID, p.Diagnosis, l.DNA AS highest_anti_DNA_result
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
  AND CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) = (
      SELECT MAX(CAST(l2.DNA AS REAL))
      FROM Patient AS p2
      JOIN Laboratory AS l2 ON l2.ID = p2.ID
      WHERE p2.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
        AND l2.DNA IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT
  CASE WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital'
       ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
  END AS care_setting,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.IGG > 900 AND l.IGG < 2000 THEN p.ID END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID),
    1
  ) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS p
LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l
  ON l.ID = p.ID
 AND l.Date = (
   SELECT MAX(l2.Date)
   FROM Laboratory AS l2
   WHERE l2.ID = p.ID
     AND l2.IGG IS NOT NULL
 )
WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
GROUP BY p.Admission
ORDER BY p.Admission DESC;

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS max_date
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 32 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 32 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM latest x
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = x.ID AND l.Date = x.max_date
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT
        l.ID,
        l.RNP,
        l.CPK,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.ID ORDER BY l.Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
) AS most_recent
WHERE rn = 1
  AND CAST(RNP AS REAL) > 64
  AND CPK < 250;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    / COUNT(*),
    2
  ) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
  AND Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%SLE susp%'
  AND Admission IN ('+', '-');

SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination AS e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
  )
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY p.SEX;

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE date("First Date") BETWEEN '1998-02-15' AND '1998-02-28'
  AND Admission IN ('+', '+(')
ORDER BY julianday("First Date") - julianday(Birthday) DESC, ID ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM"), 1) AS average_acl_igm
FROM Examination
WHERE "Examination Date" >= '1993-10-01'
  AND "Examination Date" <= '1993-10-31'
  AND Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%';

SELECT
    p.Admission,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count,
    ROUND(AVG(
        CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
        - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday))
    ), 1) AS average_completed_age
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.RBC < 3.5
  )
GROUP BY p.Admission
ORDER BY p.Admission;

SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS number_of_patients
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
  )
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY CASE p.SEX WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(e.`aCL IgM`), 2) AS avg_acl_igm
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SJS%'
  AND p.Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%SJS susp%'
  AND e.`aCL IgM` IS NOT NULL
  AND e.`aCL IgM` <> 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SjS%'
  AND e.Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%SjS susp%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND (
    LOWER(TRIM(l.RNP)) = 'negative'
    OR (TRIM(l.RNP) <> '' AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) = 0)
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND LOWER(TRIM(l.SM)) IN ('negative', '0')
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.`U-PRO` IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(l.`U-PRO`) NOT IN ('-', 'TR')
      AND CAST(TRIM(l.`U-PRO`) AS REAL) >= 30
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
      AND e.Thrombosis IS NOT NULL
      AND e.Thrombosis <> 0
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG((julianday('2026-10-09') - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.2425), 1) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
  AND (julianday('2026-10-09') - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.2425 < 70
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 64
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.WBC > 3.5
  AND l.WBC < 9.0
  AND (l.FG <= 150 OR l.FG >= 450)
  AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 15;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    1
) AS women_percentage
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE date(p.Birthday) >= date('1936-01-01')
  AND date(p.Birthday) < date('1957-01-01')
  AND p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.CPK >= 250
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.Date BETWEEN '1981-01-01' AND '1986-12-31'
  AND l.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400
  AND l.`U-PRO` IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(l.`U-PRO`) NOT IN ('-', '0')
  AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
      - (strftime('%m-%d', l.Date) < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) < 50;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = '-'
),
oxygen_counts AS (
  SELECT e.molecule_id,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN LOWER(a.element) = 'o' THEN 1 END) AS oxygen_count
  FROM eligible e
  LEFT JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = e.molecule_id
  GROUP BY e.molecule_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS avg_oxygen_atoms
FROM oxygen_counts;

SELECT AVG(single_bonds) AS average_single_bonds
FROM (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS single_bonds
  FROM molecule AS m
  JOIN bond AS b
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
   AND b.bond_type = '-'
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
);

WITH element_counts AS (
  SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS atom_count
  FROM atom AS a
  JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '-'
  GROUP BY a.element
)
SELECT element
FROM element_counts
WHERE atom_count = (SELECT MIN(atom_count) FROM element_counts);

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lower(a.element) = 'i' THEN a.atom_id END) AS iodine_atoms,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lower(a.element) = 's' THEN a.atom_id END) AS sulfur_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT b.bond_type,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS carcinogenic
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR010'
GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, b.bond_type
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_atoms
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '#'
)
AND molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE LOWER(element) IN ('p', 'br')
);

WITH eligible_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '-'
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(a.element) = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    4
) AS percentage_chlorine
FROM atom AS a
JOIN eligible_molecules AS e
    ON a.molecule_id = e.molecule_id;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(a.element) = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) || '/' || COUNT(*) AS hydrogen_fraction,
  m.label AS carcinogenicity_label
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cc_double_bonds
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = '='
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
    WHERE c.bond_id = b.bond_id
      AND LOWER(a.element) = 'c'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    WHERE c.bond_id = b.bond_id
      AND LOWER(a.element) = 'c'
  );

WITH plus_atoms AS (
    SELECT a.atom_id, a.element
    FROM atom AS a
    JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
),
bonded_atoms AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pa.atom_id, pa.element
    FROM plus_atoms AS pa
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM connected AS c
        WHERE c.atom_id = pa.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = pa.atom_id
    )
),
element_counts AS (
    SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS bonded_atom_count
    FROM bonded_atoms
    GROUP BY element
)
SELECT element,
       ROUND(100.0 * bonded_atom_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plus_atoms), 2)
           AS percent_of_all_plus_atoms
FROM element_counts
WHERE bonded_atom_count = (SELECT MAX(bonded_atom_count) FROM element_counts);

SELECT
  m.molecule_id,
  CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS carcinogenic,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN b.bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 END) AS multiple_bonds
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR041_10'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;

SELECT
  CASE b.bond_type
    WHEN '-' THEN 'single'
    WHEN '=' THEN 'double'
    WHEN '#' THEN 'triple'
  END AS bond_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND LOWER(a1.element) = 'c'
  AND LOWER(a2.element) = 'c'
GROUP BY b.bond_type
ORDER BY CASE b.bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 1 WHEN '=' THEN 2 WHEN '#' THEN 3 END;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT adjacent.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM atom AS sulfur
JOIN molecule AS molecule
  ON molecule.molecule_id = sulfur.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS connection
  ON connection.atom_id = sulfur.atom_id
JOIN atom AS adjacent
  ON adjacent.atom_id = connection.atom_id2
WHERE sulfur.element = 's'
  AND molecule.label = '+';

WITH rare_elements AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.element, a.molecule_id
    FROM atom AS a
    WHERE a.element IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM atom AS other
          WHERE other.element = a.element
            AND other.molecule_id <> a.molecule_id
      )
),
eligible_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r.molecule_id
    FROM rare_elements AS r
    JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = r.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
)
SELECT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN eligible_molecules AS e ON e.molecule_id = b.molecule_id;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM molecule m
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom a
    WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND a.element = 'n'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom a
    JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND a.element = 'n'
      AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS atoms_bonded_to_chlorine
FROM connected c
JOIN atom chlorine ON chlorine.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE LOWER(chlorine.element) = 'cl';

WITH triple_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '#'
),
counts AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carcinogenic,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_carcinogenic
    FROM triple_bond_molecules AS t
    JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = t.molecule_id
)
SELECT
    ROUND(100.0 * carcinogenic / total, 2) AS carcinogenic_percent,
    ROUND(100.0 * non_carcinogenic / total, 2) AS non_carcinogenic_percent
FROM counts;

WITH atom_counts AS (
    SELECT
        molecule_id,
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_atoms,
        SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(element) = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_atoms,
        SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(element) = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chlorine_atoms
    FROM atom
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),
bond_counts AS (
    SELECT
        molecule_id,
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_bonds
    FROM bond
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),
carbon_touching_counts AS (
    SELECT
        b.molecule_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS carbon_touching_bonds
    FROM bond AS b
    JOIN connected AS c
        ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN atom AS a
        ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
    WHERE LOWER(a.element) = 'c'
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        m.molecule_id,
        m.label AS carcinogenicity_label,
        ac.number_of_atoms,
        COALESCE(bc.number_of_bonds, 0) AS number_of_bonds,
        ac.carbon_atoms,
        ac.chlorine_atoms,
        COALESCE(ctc.carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS carbon_touching_bonds,
        COALESCE(bc.multiple_bonds, 0) AS multiple_bonds,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY
                COALESCE(ctc.carbon_touching_bonds, 0) DESC,
                ac.number_of_atoms DESC,
                m.molecule_id ASC
        ) AS rank_position
    FROM molecule AS m
    JOIN atom_counts AS ac
        ON ac.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    LEFT JOIN bond_counts AS bc
        ON bc.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    LEFT JOIN carbon_touching_counts AS ctc
        ON ctc.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE ac.carbon_atoms > 0
)
SELECT
    rank_position,
    molecule_id,
    carcinogenicity_label,
    number_of_atoms,
    number_of_bonds,
    carbon_atoms,
    chlorine_atoms,
    carbon_touching_bonds,
    multiple_bonds
FROM ranked
ORDER BY rank_position;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS hydrogen_bonds
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a1.molecule_id = 'TR499'
  AND (LOWER(a1.element) = 'h' OR LOWER(a2.element) = 'h');

SELECT a2.element AS element, COUNT(*) AS bond_count
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND a1.element = 'c'
  AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
GROUP BY a2.element
ORDER BY a2.element;

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS m
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom AS a
    WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND LOWER(a.element) IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb', 'mg', 'li')
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bond AS b
    WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND b.bond_type = '-'
  )
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT a.element, COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM atom AS a
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    WHERE (c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id)
      AND b.bond_type = '-'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    WHERE (c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id)
      AND b.bond_type <> '-'
)
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element;

SELECT a.element AS element_symbol,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM atom AS a
JOIN bond AS b
  ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND a.element IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element_symbol ASC;

SELECT a.element, COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS bonded_atom_count
FROM atom AS a
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR397'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected AS c
    WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id
       OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
  )
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element;
